lines.en: He said, "But who is my neighbor?"
lines.zh: 他說：「誰是我的鄰舍呢？」

lines.en: And Jesus answering him said, "A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among thieves,
lines.zh: 耶穌回答說：「有一個人從耶路撒冷下耶利哥去，落在強盜手中。

lines.en: which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead."
lines.zh: 他們剝去他的衣裳，把他打個半死，就丟下他走了。」

lines.en: "And by chance there came down a certain priest that way;
lines.zh: 「偶然有一個祭司從這條路下來，

lines.en: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side."
lines.zh: 看見他，就從那邊過去了。」

lines.en: "And likewise a Levite, when he was in the place,
lines.zh: 「又有一個利未人來到這地方，

lines.en: came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side."
lines.zh: 看見他，也照樣從那邊過去了。」

lines.en: "But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was:
lines.zh: 「惟有一個撒馬利亞人行路來到那裡，

lines.en: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him."
lines.zh: 看見他，就動了慈心。」

lines.en: And notice, he did ten things:
lines.zh: 注意，他做了十件事：

lines.en: he had compassion on him, and he went to him, and he bound up his wounds, poured in oil, poured in wine,
lines.zh: 他對他動了慈心，上前去，包裹他的傷口，倒上油和酒，

lines.en: set him on his own horse, or his beast, and took him to an inn and took care of him.
lines.zh: 扶他騎上自己的馬，或者說他的牲口，帶到客店裡去照應他。

lines.en: "And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host,
lines.zh: 「第二天他離開時，拿出二錢銀子來，交給店主，

lines.en: and said unto him, Take care of him;
lines.zh: 說：『你且照應他；

lines.en: and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee."
lines.zh: 此外所費用的，我回來必還你。』」

lines.en: "Which now of these three, thinkest thou," said Jesus to the lawyer,
lines.zh: 耶穌對律法師說：「你想，這三個人

lines.en: "was the neighbor unto him that fell among the thieves?"
lines.zh: 哪一個是落在強盜手中的鄰舍呢？」

lines.en: And the lawyer answered, "He that showed mercy on him."
lines.zh: 律法師回答說：「是憐憫他的。」

lines.en: Then said Jesus, "Go thou, and do likewise."
lines.zh: 耶穌說：「你去照樣行吧。」

lines.en: Jesus gave this story as an answer to these two questions that this lawyer asked.
lines.zh: 耶穌講這個故事，是為了回答這位律法師提出的這兩個問題。

lines.en: The first question: "Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?"
lines.zh: 第一個問題：「夫子！我該做甚麼才可以承受永生？」

lessons.title: The Good Samaritan
lessons.summaryZh: 永生是從認識基督開始，而我們對周遭受苦的鄰舍負有愛的責任。

lines.en: Everybody would like to know that when you die, you're going to heaven.
lines.zh: 每個人都想知道，當死後你會上天堂。

lines.en: You know you're going to die.
lines.zh: 你知道你將會面臨死亡。

lines.en: It is appointed unto man once to die.
lines.zh: 按著定命，人人都有一死。

lines.en: You cannot escape death.
lines.zh: 你無法逃避死亡。

lines.en: But you'd like to know that you have eternal life.
lines.zh: 但你想要知道你擁有永生。

lines.en: Now, eternal life does not begin at death.
lines.zh: 然而，永生並不是在死後才開始。

lines.en: Eternal life begins the moment you know Christ as your Lord and Savior.
lines.zh: 永生是從你認識基督為你主和救主的那一刻就開始了。

lines.en: There are many people that are here and now, alive physically, but you're dead spiritually.
lines.zh: 有許多人此時此地在肉體上是活著的，但在屬靈上你卻是死的。

lines.en: You're dead toward God.
lines.zh: 你對神是死的。

lines.en: You have no relationship and no fellowship with God whatsoever.
lines.zh: 你與神之間沒有任何關係，也沒有絲毫團契。

lines.en: You go to church, and you go through all the rituals,
lines.zh: 你去教會，經歷所有的儀式，

lines.en: and you have religion, but you don't really have Jesus Christ.
lines.zh: 你擁有了宗教，但你並沒有真正擁有耶穌基督。

lines.en: And so, religion becomes rather dull to you.
lines.zh: 因此，宗教對你來說變得相當枯燥。

lines.en: It's a disappointment to you.
lines.zh: 它讓你感到失望。

lines.en: So you try to find your kicks in drugs, or sex, or something else.
lines.zh: 所以你試圖在毒品、性或其他事物中尋找刺激。

lines.en: You turn to other things to escape,
lines.zh: 你轉向其他事物來逃避，

lines.en: because there's always this empty place in everybody's heart,
lines.zh: 因為在每個人的心中，總有這樣一個空處，

lines.en: that only God can fill, because you were made in the image of God,
lines.zh: 只有神能填滿，因為你是照著神的形像造的，

lines.en: and without God, there's an emptiness, there's a lacking.
lines.zh: 若沒有神，就會有一種空虛，一種缺失。

lines.en: Yet you're always, all your life, searching for something,
lines.zh: 然而你終其一生，總是在尋找某種東西，

lines.en: and you're searching for eternal life.
lines.zh: 你在尋找永生。

lines.en: You want eternal life.
lines.zh: 你想要永生。

lines.en: You can have eternal life right tonight.
lines.zh: 你就在今晚就可以擁有永生。

lines.en: It could start tonight in your heart, as Christ comes to dwell in your life and in your heart.
lines.zh: 當基督進入你的生命和你的心中居住時，它今晚就可以在你心裡開始。

lines.en: It was a social question: "Who is my neighbor?"
lines.zh: 這是一個社會性的問題：「誰是我的鄰舍呢？」

lines.en: Jesus gave the answer.
lines.zh: 耶穌給了答案。

lines.en: "Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart,
lines.zh: 「你要盡心愛主你的神，

lines.en: with all thy soul, with all thy strength,
lines.zh: 盡性、盡力，

lines.en: and thy neighbor as thyself."
lines.zh: 又要愛鄰舍如同自己。」

lines.en: 850 million people on this planet live on a starvation diet at this moment.
lines.zh: 這一刻，地球上有八億五千萬人正處於極度飢餓狀態。

vocab.zh: 飢餓飲食 (極度缺乏食物)

lines.en: Are they our neighbors?
lines.zh: 他們是我們的鄰舍嗎？

lines.en: When is the last time you shared your social life with someone of another race or another ethnic background,
lines.zh: 你上一次與不同種族或不同文化背景的人分享你的社交生活，

lines.en: or your material goods with the poor,
lines.zh: 或是將你的物質財富分享給窮人，

lines.en: or your knowledge with those who need an education,
lines.zh: 或是將你的知識分享給那些需要教育的人，

lines.en: or your skills with the untrained,
lines.zh: 或是將你的技能分享給未受過訓練的人，

lines.en: and your compassion and prayers for the peace of the world?
lines.zh: 以及為世界和平獻上你的憐憫和代禱，是在什麼時候呢？

lines.en: Have you cared for the aged, the handicapped, the blind, the alcoholic, the dope addict,
lines.zh: 你是否關心過年長者、殘疾人士、盲人、酗酒者和染上毒癮的人，

lines.en: the morally fallen, with your love and concern?
lines.zh: 並且用你的愛與關懷去照顧那些道德墮落的人？

lines.en: Who is your neighbor?
lines.zh: 誰是你的鄰舍？

lines.en: What is your responsibility to your neighbor?
lines.zh: 你對你的鄰舍有什麼責任？

lines.en: In the modern world of transportation and technology,
lines.zh: 在這個交通和科技發達的現代世界中，

lines.en: the whole world has become a neighborhood, without being a brotherhood.
lines.zh: 整個世界已經變成了一個社區，卻沒有成為一個弟兄和睦同居的群體。

lines.en: The whole world suddenly becomes our neighbor.
lines.zh: 整個世界突然都成了我們的鄰舍。

lines.en: Those people that are suffering in Southeast Asia are our neighbors.
lines.zh: 那些在東南亞受苦的人是我們的鄰舍。

lines.en: Those people suffering in Central Africa are our neighbors,
lines.zh: 那些在中非受苦的人也是我們的鄰舍，

lines.en: and we have a responsibility to them.
lines.zh: 而我們對他們負有責任。

lines.en: The Scripture says Jesus came to heal the broken-hearted.
lines.zh: 聖經上說，耶穌來是要醫治傷心的人。

lines.en: A new book has just come out by a psychiatrist entitled, The Broken Heart.
lines.zh: 最近一位精神科醫生剛出版了一本新書，書名叫做《破碎的心》。

lines.en: And in Toronto, delegates came from all around the world to a convention on mended hearts.
lines.zh: 在多倫多，來自世界各地的代表參加了一個關於修復心靈的大會。

lines.en: Jesus came to heal broken hearts.
lines.zh: 耶穌來，就是要醫治破碎的心。

lines.en: How many broken hearts are here tonight?
lines.zh: 今晚這裡有多少顆破碎的心？

lessons.title: The Good Samaritan
lessons.summaryZh: 耶穌指出屬靈的疾病比肉體更嚴重，我們都在罪的墮落之路上，需要基督拯救。

lines.en: And then there was a spiritual question, not only a social question, but a spiritual question.
lines.zh: 接下來有一個屬靈的問題，不僅是一個社會的問題，而是一個屬靈的問題。

lines.en: Throughout history, the church has shifted back and forth as to its emphasis on personal redemption and social involvement.
lines.zh: 縱觀歷史，教會在強調個人救贖和社會參與之間搖擺不定。

lines.en: They both go hand in hand.
lines.zh: 這兩者是息息相關的。

lines.en: But this man said, "Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?"
lines.zh: 但這人說：「夫子！我該做什麼才可以承受永生？」

lines.en: And the spiritual poverty of that man was deeper and worse than the material poverty.
lines.zh: 而那個人在屬靈上的貧窮，比物質上的貧窮更深、更糟。

lines.en: And Jesus showed that over and over again, that the spiritual disease is worse than the physical disease.
lines.zh: 耶穌一再地表明，屬靈的疾病比身體的疾病更嚴重。

lines.en: We can go out to Southeast Asia right now to Thailand, to some of those camps, and it'll break your heart.
lines.zh: 我們現在可以去東南亞的泰國，去那些難民營看看，那會讓你心碎。

lines.en: My son has been there several times and told me some of the most horrifying stories.
lines.zh: 我兒子去過那裡好幾次，並告訴了我一些最駭人聽聞的故事。

lines.en: We see it on our television screens and we say, "What can we do?"
lines.zh: 我們在電視螢幕上看到這些，然後我們說：「我們能做什麼？」

lines.en: We feel so helpless in a moment when people are suffering so terribly in so many parts of the world.
lines.zh: 當世界各地有這麼多人正在遭受如此可怕的苦難時，我們感到非常無助。

lines.en: It's overwhelming to us.
lines.zh: 這對我們來說太沉重了。

vocab.zh: 壓倒性的；令人不知所措的

lines.en: We're to do what we can, they are our neighbors.
lines.zh: 我們應該盡己所能，他們是我們的鄰舍。

lines.en: But there's another disease, right here in Halifax, right here in Nova Scotia, that is worse than the diseases in those camps.
lines.zh: 但還有另一種疾病，就在哈利法克斯，就在新斯科細亞省這裡，比那些難民營裡的疾病更嚴重。

lines.en: It's the spiritual disease, the disease of sin.
lines.zh: 這是屬靈的疾病，是罪的疾病。

lines.en: And you've got it.
lines.zh: 而你染上了它。

lines.en: It's a leprosy.
lines.zh: 這是大痲瘋。

lines.en: It's worse than cancer because it destroys the soul.
lines.zh: 它比癌症更糟，因為它會毀滅靈魂。

lines.en: It destroys your relationship with God.
lines.zh: 它會破壞你與神的關係。

lines.en: It comes between you and peace, and joy, and happiness.
lines.zh: 它阻礙了你獲得平安、喜樂和幸福。

lines.en: You need to turn your life over to Christ and have this eternal life.
lines.zh: 你需要將你的生命交託給基督，並得著這永生。

lines.en: "What must I do to be saved?"
lines.zh: 「我當怎樣行才可以得救？」

lines.en: "How can we be saved?"
lines.zh: 「我們怎樣才能得救？」

lines.en: That's the same question that was asked Paul and Silas in prison.
lines.zh: 這和保羅與西拉在監獄裡被問到的問題是一樣的。

lines.en: And Paul said, "Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved."
lines.zh: 保羅說：「當信主耶穌，你必得救。」

lines.en: But it's not only a social and spiritual, but it's an individual problem.
lines.zh: 但這不僅是一個社會和屬靈的問題，它也是一個個人的問題。

lines.en: Jesus said, "A certain man..."
lines.zh: 耶穌說：「有一個人……」

lines.en: Now Jesus is interested in you as an individual.
lines.zh: 耶穌對你這個個體很感興趣。

lines.en: He sees the sparrow when it falls, He said,
lines.zh: 祂說，當麻雀掉落地面時，祂看見了，

lines.en: and He has the hairs of your head numbered, and He sees you as an individual.
lines.zh: 祂連你們的頭髮也都被數過了，祂把你當作一個獨立的個體來看待。

lines.en: He said, "A certain man..."
lines.zh: 祂說：「有一個人……」

lines.en: He loves people.
lines.zh: 祂愛世人。

lines.en: Behold, how He loved him.
lines.zh: 看哪，祂是何等地愛他。

lines.en: "Greater love hath no man than this, that he lay down his life for his friends."
lines.zh: 「人為朋友捨命，人的愛心沒有比這個大的。」

lines.en: And the Scripture says this certain man in this story went down.
lines.zh: 聖經說這個故事裡的『有一個人』下去了。

lines.en: He went down from Jerusalem to Jericho.
lines.zh: 他從耶路撒冷下耶利哥去。

lines.en: Jericho was 800 feet below Jerusalem, about 18 miles away.
lines.zh: 耶利哥在耶路撒冷下方八百英尺處，大約十八英里遠。

lines.en: And a certain man went down the Jericho road.
lines.zh: 有一個人沿著耶利哥的路下去。

lines.en: Now Jerusalem was the place of the city of God; it was a city of peace at that time.
lines.zh: 耶路撒冷是神的城；在當時，它是一座和平之城。

lines.en: It was a city of truth, it was a city where the theologians were.
lines.zh: 它是一座真理之城，是一座神學家所在的城市。

lines.en: But now, he was going down.
lines.zh: 但現在，他正在往下走。

lines.en: That's the downward course of sin, and we're all on that downward Jericho road.
lines.zh: 那就是罪的墮落之路，而我們都在那條向下走的耶利哥之路上。

lines.en: Every one of us.
lines.zh: 我們每一個人。

lines.en: And if you read the Scriptures and read the first chapter of Romans,
lines.zh: 如果你讀聖經，讀到《羅馬書》第一章，

lines.en: you'll find that sin starts in the very beginning and leads us downward, downward, downward, downward.
lines.zh: 你會發現罪從一開始就發生，並將我們引向墮落、墮落、再墮落。

lines.en: And like the shadow when it declined, said the Psalmist, "I am tossed down."
lines.zh: 就像詩篇作者所說的：「我如日影偏斜而去，我被拋下。」

lines.en: And this certain man was on his way down, like you are on your way down.
lines.zh: 這個人正在往下走，就像你正在墮落的路上。

lines.en: The president of the United Nations is right when he said,
lines.zh: 聯合國大會主席說得對：

lines.en: "We will never make war obsolete until we find a force that will bridle the passions of men and nations."
lines.zh: 「在我們找到一種能夠約束人類與國家情慾的力量之前，我們永遠無法消除戰爭。」

lines.en: Jesus Christ on that cross can transform the human life and change hate to love.
lines.zh: 十字架上的耶穌基督能轉化人的生命，將仇恨化為愛。

lines.en: "A certain man fell among thieves, and they stripped him of his raiment and wounded him."
lines.zh: 「有一個人落在強盜手中，他們剝去他的衣裳，把他打傷了。」

lines.en: And we have all fallen in with the devil and his demons.
lines.zh: 我們也都落入了魔鬼和牠的邪靈手中。

lines.en: And they've stripped us, they've wounded us, they've left us for dead.
lines.zh: 牠們剝去了我們的衣裳，打傷了我們，把我們打個半死就撇下我們走了。

vocab.zh: 把...打個半死就丟下不管

lessons.title: The Good Samaritan
lessons.summaryZh: 世界充滿毀壞人的罪惡與迷惑人的假先知，唯有來到十字架前才能尋得豐盛生命與永生。

lines.en: "The thief cometh not but to steal, and to kill, and to destroy."
lines.zh: 「盜賊來，無非要偷竊，殺害，毀壞。」

lines.en: "I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly."
lines.zh: 「我來了，是要叫他們得生命，並且得的更豐盛。」

lines.en: Notice the difference: there's a thief that comes to kill, to destroy; to kill you.
lines.zh: 注意這區別：有一個盜賊來是為了殺害、毀壞；要殺害你。

lines.en: But Jesus said, "I've come to give them life, and to give them life more abundantly."
lines.zh: 但耶穌說：「我來是要賜給他們生命，並賜給他們更豐盛的生命。」

lines.en: All over the world sin is rampaging, raping, ravaging humanity: violence, terrorism.
lines.zh: 在世界各地，罪惡正在肆虐、強暴、蹂躪人類：暴力、恐怖主義。

lines.en: We read it every day in our newspapers: murder, muggers and rapists in our major cities have become a major problem.
lines.zh: 我們每天在報紙上讀到：謀殺，我們大城市的搶劫犯和強姦犯已成為一個重大問題。

lines.en: Thieves have wounded and stripped this man, and departed from him, and left him half dead; alone and forsaken.
lines.zh: 強盜打傷並剝去這人的衣服，就離開了他，把他留下半死不活；孤單且被遺棄。

lines.en: When he came to and got his consciousness back, he found himself crushed and unable to move, just like you.
lines.zh: 當他甦醒過來並恢復意識時，他發現自己被壓垮且無法動彈，就像你一樣。

lines.en: One day you'll wake up.
lines.zh: 有一天你會醒來。

lines.en: You'll find yourself-- sin has destroyed you, and you cannot move.
lines.zh: 你會發現自己——罪已經毀滅了你，而你無法動彈。

lines.en: The Bible says that we're dead in sins and trespasses.
lines.zh: 聖經說我們死在過犯和罪惡之中。

lines.en: The Bible says, "She that liveth in pleasure is dead while she lives."
lines.zh: 聖經說：「那好宴樂的寡婦，正活著的時候也是死的。」

lines.en: You can be physically alive, but spiritually dead.
lines.zh: 你可能身體活著，靈裡卻是死的。

lines.en: Your soul is dead.
lines.zh: 你的靈魂是死的。

lines.en: It cannot save itself, it cannot move, it cannot get up out of the ditch.
lines.zh: 它無法自救，無法動彈，無法從溝渠中爬起來。

lines.en: It cannot heal those wounds.
lines.zh: 它無法治癒那些傷口。

lines.en: That's why Christ came and died on the cross.
lines.zh: 這就是為什麼基督降世並死在十字架上。

lines.en: "The wages of sin is death."
lines.zh: 「罪的工價乃是死。」

lines.en: The man is going to die; you're going to die.
lines.zh: 那個人快要死了；你也快要死了。

lines.en: And then there came some salvation quacks along.
lines.zh: 然後出現了一些救恩的庸醫。

lines.en: The world is full of false messiahs, and false prophets, and false christs.
lines.zh: 這個世界充滿了假彌賽亞、假先知和假基督。

lines.en: Jonestown down in Guyana is still fresh in our memories where Jim Jones went and 900 people died.
lines.zh: 位於蓋亞那的瓊斯鎮在我們記憶中依然猶新，吉姆·瓊斯去到那裡，有九百人喪生。

lines.en: And how many of those false cults there are all over the world today, these false messiahs promising all kinds of things.
lines.zh: 今天在世界各地有多少那樣的異端邪教，這些假彌賽亞應許各樣的事情。

lines.en: Jesus said, "Take heed that no man deceive you."
lines.zh: 耶穌說：「你們要謹慎，免得有人迷惑你們。」

lines.en: He warned that many false prophets shall rise and shall deceive many.
lines.zh: 祂警告說，將有許多假先知起來，迷惑多人。

lines.en: Paul said, "Evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived, as we approach the end of the age."
lines.zh: 保羅說：「作惡的和迷惑人的，必越久越惡，欺哄人也被人欺哄，隨著我們接近這世代的終結。」

lines.en: John said many antichrists would come.
lines.zh: 約翰說會有許多敵基督到來。

lines.en: He said, "Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God," because of the false prophets that have gone out into the world.
lines.zh: 他說：「親愛的弟兄啊，一切的靈，你們不可都信，總要試驗那些靈是出於神的不是，」因為有許多假先知已經出來了。

lines.en: Then as we approach the end of the age, they will intensify, they will get worse and worse, and more believable all the time.
lines.zh: 然後隨著我們接近這世代的終結，他們會變本加厲，他們會變得越來越糟，且越來越令人信以為真。

vocab.zh: 可信的（令人信以為真的）

lines.en: Many people will follow them to their doom and to their death.
lines.zh: 許多人會跟隨他們步向滅亡和死亡。

lines.en: A priest came along... think of it now, a priest came along: a preacher, a clergyman.
lines.zh: 有一個祭司走過來……現在想一想，一個祭司走過來：一個傳道人，一個神職人員。

lines.en: And it says that he looked over and he saw this man over there suffering and dying and wounded and stripped.
lines.zh: 經上說他看過去，看到這人在那裡受苦、垂死、受傷且被剝去衣服。

lines.en: And he passed by on the other side.
lines.zh: 他卻從另一邊過去了。

lines.en: Now he was too busy on his way, probably to a religious conference, to stop and help this poor man.
lines.zh: 當時他在路上太忙了，可能正要去參加一個宗教會議，以至於無法停下來幫助這個可憐的人。

lines.en: Paul wrote to Timothy, "Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof."
lines.zh: 保羅寫信給提摩太：「有敬虔的外貌，卻背了敬虔的實意。」

lines.en: You see, religion will not save anybody.
lines.zh: 你看，宗教不能拯救任何人。

lines.en: People say, "Oh, I'm religious."
lines.zh: 人們說：「哦，我很虔誠。」

lines.en: Sure, you have religion, but that's not going to save you.
lines.zh: 沒錯，你有宗教信仰，但那救不了你。

lines.en: You are saved by Jesus Christ.
lines.zh: 你是藉著耶穌基督得救的。

lines.en: By the blood that was shed on the cross, by His resurrection, by what is called in the Bible the kerygma: the story of Christ on the cross.
lines.zh: 藉著在十字架上所流的血，藉著祂的復活，藉著聖經中所稱的「初傳」：基督在十字架上的故事。

lines.en: When God took your sins and laid them on Christ, and He became sin for us who knew no sin.
lines.zh: 當神將你的罪孽擔當並歸在基督身上，祂便使那無罪的，替我們成為罪。

lines.en: That's the only way anybody's going to be saved.
lines.zh: 這是任何人得救的唯一途徑。

lines.en: I don't care who you are.
lines.zh: 我不在乎你是誰。

lines.en: No one is going to go to the Kingdom of Heaven except the way God said go.
lines.zh: 除了神所說的道路，沒有人能進神的國度。

lines.en: You might not like it that way, but that's the way it is.
lines.zh: 你可能不喜歡那樣，但事實就是如此。

lines.en: "There is a way that seemeth right unto man, but the end thereof are the ways of death," says the Bible.
lines.zh: 聖經說：「有一條路，人以為正，至終成為死亡之路。」

lines.en: Come to the cross!
lines.zh: 來到十字架前！

lines.en: Find forgiveness and eternal life.
lines.zh: 尋得赦免與永生。

lines.en: Then you have the ability and then you have the vision to go out and help your neighbor.
lines.zh: 然後你才有能力，也才有異象去幫助你的鄰舍。

lessons.title: The Good Samaritan
lessons.summaryZh: 我們不能靠好行為得救，唯有神的憐憫與深愛能拯救我們脫離罪惡。
lessons.ref: 約翰一書 5:13, 路加福音 10:33

lines.en: People say they can be saved by doing the best they can.
lines.zh: 人們說只要盡力做到最好就能得救。

lines.en: I saw a poll in New Jersey some time ago that said ninety-two percent of the people said they hope to go to heaven, but they were not sure.
lines.zh: 不久前我在紐澤西州看到一項民調顯示，百分之九十二的人說他們希望能上天堂，但他們並不確定。

lines.en: But John said, "We know that we've passed from death unto life."
lines.zh: 但約翰說：「我們知道我們已經出死入生了。」

lines.en: Peter said, "For as much as ye know that you were redeemed."
lines.zh: 彼得說：「知道你們得贖。」

lines.en: Paul said, "I know in whom I have believed and am persuaded that He is able to keep that which I've committed unto Him against that day."
lines.zh: 保羅說：「因為知道我所信的是誰，也深信祂能保全我所交付祂的，直到那日。」

lines.en: The apostle John said, "These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God, that ye may know that ye have eternal life."
lines.zh: 使徒約翰說：「我將這些話寫給你們信奉神兒子之名的人，要叫你們知道自己有永生。」

lines.en: You don't have to doubt it.
lines.zh: 你不需要懷疑。

lines.en: Do you doubt that you're going to heaven tonight?
lines.zh: 你懷疑今晚自己能否上天堂嗎？

lines.en: Do you doubt that you have eternal life?
lines.zh: 你懷疑自己是否有永生嗎？

lines.en: Do you doubt that your sins are forgiven?
lines.zh: 你懷疑自己的罪是否已蒙赦免嗎？

lines.en: Is there a doubt in your heart?
lines.zh: 你的心裡有懷疑嗎？

lines.en: If there is, then I'd make sure, tonight!
lines.zh: 如果有的話，今晚就來確定吧！

lines.en: You say, "I've been baptized, I've been confirmed, I've done everything I was told to do," but you're not sure.
lines.zh: 你說：「我受過洗，我堅信過，我做了一切吩咐我做的事」，但你還是不確定。

lines.en: Come and make sure.
lines.zh: 來確定一下吧。

lines.en: Recommit your life.
lines.zh: 重新將你的生命交託給神。

lines.en: Reconfirm your life.
lines.zh: 重新確認你的生命。

lines.en: Reconfirm what your parents promised at baptism.
lines.zh: 重新確認你父母在你受洗時所應許的。

lines.en: Reconfirm what you promised.
lines.zh: 重新確認你所應許的。

lines.en: Many people need to do that.
lines.zh: 許多人需要這麼做。

lines.en: I needed to do that.
lines.zh: 我以前也需要這麼做。

lines.en: I was brought up in the church; baptized, confirmed, and all the rest.
lines.zh: 我在教會長大；受洗、堅信禮，以及一切的儀式我都經歷過。

lines.en: But I still didn't really know Christ as my Savior and my Lord.
lines.zh: 但我仍然沒有真正認識基督是我個人的救主和主宰。

lines.en: There came a time when I had to say, "Yes, Lord, I will receive You, I will turn from my sins, I will allow You to change my way of living."
lines.zh: 直到有一個時刻，我必須說：「是的，主啊，我要接受祢，我要轉離我的罪，我要讓祢改變我的生活方式。」

lines.en: "Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to His mercy He saved us."
lines.zh: 「祂便救了我們，並不是因我們自己所行的義，乃是照祂的憐憫。」

lines.en: So the wounded, derelict man was left to die; the priest and the Levite unwilling to save him.
lines.zh: 所以那受傷、被遺棄的人就被留在原地等死；祭司和利未人不願意救他。

lines.en: And Jesus now shows us the simplicity and the saving power of the gospel.
lines.zh: 現在耶穌向我們展現了福音的簡單明瞭與拯救大能。

lines.en: "A certain Samaritan came along..."
lines.zh: 「惟有一個撒馬利亞人行路來到那裡……」

lines.en: Now a Samaritan was a half-caste; he was half Gentile and half Jewish.
lines.zh: 撒馬利亞人是混血兒；他有一半外邦人血統，一半猶太人血統。

lines.en: The Jews and the Gentiles at that time had nothing to do with each other, and certainly the Jews and the Samaritans had nothing to do with each other.
lines.zh: 當時的猶太人和外邦人互不往來，猶太人和撒馬利亞人更是如此。

lines.en: They didn't trust each other in that ancient day.
lines.zh: 在那個古老的時代，他們互不信任。

lines.en: They do today, but they didn't at that time.
lines.zh: 他們今天會，但在當時並不會。

lines.en: And so this Samaritan, who normally would have nothing to do with somebody of another ethnic background, came along and saw what happened.
lines.zh: 所以這位平常不會和其他種族背景的人有任何瓜葛的撒馬利亞人，走過來並看到了發生的事。

lines.en: Now he could have said to himself, "I have no responsibility for this guy.
lines.zh: 他本來可以在心裡說：「我對這個人沒有責任。

lines.en: He got in his own trouble.
lines.zh: 他是自找麻煩。

lines.en: He should have come along armed and ready for the thieves and the robbers on this road.
lines.zh: 他走這條路本該帶上武器，防備盜賊和強盜。

lines.en: He should have prepared himself.
lines.zh: 他本該做好準備。

lines.en: I don't have any responsibility towards him.
lines.zh: 我對他沒有任何責任。

lines.en: He's not related to me, he hates me."
lines.zh: 他跟我非親非故，而且他恨我。」

lines.en: God could have done the same with us.
lines.zh: 神本來也可以這樣對待我們。

lines.en: He could have looked at this little planet whirling out into space like a speck of dust, with little ants called people living on it.
lines.zh: 祂大可以看著這顆在太空中旋轉、像一粒微塵般的小行星，上面住著被稱為人類的小螞蟻。

lines.en: Lost, separated from Him, dying, being born, live a few years and then die; being born, live a few years and die, and sin and go on with their own pleasures defying God.
lines.zh: 迷失、與祂隔絕、步向死亡、出生、活幾年然後死去；再次出生、活幾年然後死去，繼續犯罪並在屬肉體的享樂中悖逆神。

lines.en: And He could have said, "Sweep them all into hell."
lines.zh: 祂大可以說：「把他們全掃進地獄吧。」

lines.en: He could have said, "Let's destroy the planet."
lines.zh: 祂大可以說：「我們來毀滅這顆星球吧。」

lines.en: He could have done it with a snap of His finger.
lines.zh: 祂只要彈個指頭就能做到。

lines.en: He could have done it with an order to one angel.
lines.zh: 祂只要向一位天使下達命令就能做到。

lines.en: But He didn't do it.
lines.zh: 但祂沒有這麼做。

lines.en: The Bible says, "For God so loved the world."
lines.zh: 聖經說：「神愛世人。」

lines.en: So loved.
lines.zh: 如此深愛。

lines.en: You don't understand that, do you?
lines.zh: 你不明白這一點，對吧？

lines.en: How can you?
lines.zh: 你怎麼可能明白呢？

lines.en: You can't love like that.
lines.zh: 你無法像那樣去愛。

lessons.title: The Good Samaritan
lessons.summaryZh: 耶穌像好撒馬利亞人一樣，在我們受傷、犯罪時來尋找、醫治並拯救我們。

lines.en: To save this little planet, to save you.
lines.zh: 為了拯救這顆小小的星球，為了拯救你。

lines.en: The grace of God, we didn't deserve it.
lines.zh: 神的恩典，是我們不配得的。

lines.en: Dr. Menninger, the great psychiatrist from Kansas, said, "Love is the medicine for the sickness of the world."
lines.zh: 來自堪薩斯州的偉大精神科醫師梅寧格博士說：「愛是治療世界疾病的良藥。」

lines.en: One of your former prime ministers was quoted in the press some time ago as saying he had never known a time in his whole lifetime when there was such a shortage of love.
lines.zh: 你們的一位前總理不久前在報紙上被引述說，他一生中從未見過如此缺乏愛的時代。

lines.en: I read of a woman in London, England who died at 102.
lines.zh: 我讀到英國倫敦有一位婦女，在102歲時過世了。

lines.en: For the last years of her life, she had nightly made an entry in her diary.
lines.zh: 在她生命的最後幾年，她每天晚上都會寫日記。

lines.en: And here's what her diary said day after day, and day after day.
lines.zh: 她的日記日復一日、日復一日地這樣寫著。

lines.en: "No one called today, no one loves me."
lines.zh: 「今天沒有人打電話來，沒有人愛我。」

lines.en: She died alone.
lines.zh: 她孤獨地死去了。

lines.en: But I'll tell you, somebody does love you.
lines.zh: 但我告訴你，確實有人愛你。

lines.en: I don't care what your problems are, and what your tensions are, and what your pressures are, what your sins are, and what your failures are: God loves you.
lines.zh: 我不在乎你有什麼問題，有什麼緊張，有什麼壓力，有什麼罪，有什麼失敗：神愛你。

lines.en: God loves you so much that He sent His Son to the cross to endure that terrible death for you, just for you.
lines.zh: 神如此愛你，以至於祂差遣祂的兒子上十字架，為你忍受那可怕的死亡，只為了你。

lines.en: If you'd have been the only one, He would have died for you.
lines.zh: 如果你是世界上唯一的人，祂也會為你而死。

lines.en: And so, this Samaritan went to him just as Christ will come to you tonight: in your hurt, in your distress, in your failure, in your sin.
lines.zh: 所以，這個撒馬利亞人走向他，就像基督今晚會走向你一樣：在你的傷痛、苦難、失敗和罪惡中。

lines.en: He will come to you.
lines.zh: 祂會走向你。

lines.en: He didn't just love him and leave him.
lines.zh: 他不僅僅是愛他，然後就把他撇下。

lines.en: Jesus didn't just love us and leave us, He died—He did something!
lines.zh: 耶穌也不僅僅是愛我們，然後就把我們撇下。祂死了——祂採取了行動！

lines.en: And this certain Samaritan did the same thing.
lines.zh: 而這個撒馬利亞人也做了同樣的事。

lines.en: "But God commended His love toward us in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us."
lines.zh: 「惟有基督在我們還作罪人的時候為我們死，神的愛就在此向我們顯明了。」

lines.en: Do you remember reading in the paper some time ago about this doctor from Windsor, Ontario that went down to Chicago with his wife?
lines.zh: 你還記得不久前在報紙上讀到，這位來自安大略省溫莎市的醫生和他妻子去芝加哥的事嗎？

lines.en: Now I'm not sure they were on their honeymoon, but they went down to Chicago and they ate at a restaurant.
lines.zh: 我不確定他們是否在度蜜月，但他們去了芝加哥，並在一家餐廳吃飯。

lines.en: You remember that they were held up by some robbers on the street outside in a rather nice neighborhood.
lines.zh: 你記得他們在外面一個相當不錯的社區街道上，被幾個強盜搶劫了。

lines.en: The robber pulled a gun and held it at the head of his wife or his bride.
lines.zh: 強盜拔出槍，指著他妻子或新娘的頭。

lines.en: And he rushed in between, and the robber shot him and killed him.
lines.zh: 他衝到中間，強盜開槍把他打死了。

lines.en: He was saving his wife, just as the Lord Jesus Christ rushed in for His bride: those of us who are members of His body.
lines.zh: 他在拯救他的妻子，就像主耶穌基督為祂的新娘衝鋒陷陣一樣：我們這些作為祂身體肢體的人。

lines.en: He died on the cross for us because He loved us.
lines.zh: 祂因為愛我們，而在十字架上為我們死。

lines.en: Christ loved you and died for you.
lines.zh: 基督愛你，並為你而死。

lines.en: "But God, who is rich in mercy, for His great love wherewith He loved us."
lines.zh: 「然而，神既有豐富的憐憫，因祂愛我們的大愛，」

lines.en: Notice this Samaritan bound up his wounds and poured in some oil.
lines.zh: 注意，這個撒馬利亞人包裹他的傷口，並倒上了一些油。

lines.en: Now the oil stands for the Holy Spirit.
lines.zh: 這油代表著聖靈。

lines.en: You see, the Holy Spirit comes into our hearts, and convicts us of sin.
lines.zh: 你看，聖靈進入我們的心中，叫我們為罪責備自己。

lines.en: And then after we've received Christ, the Holy Spirit comes to fill our hearts and to produce the fruit of the Spirit, and to give us gifts so that we can serve Him.
lines.zh: 然後在我們接受基督之後，聖靈來充滿我們的心，結出聖靈的果子，並賜給我們恩賜，好讓我們能服事祂。

lines.en: And then he poured in the wine, and the wine with its alcoholic content was an antiseptic that would help heal the wound.
lines.zh: 然後他倒進了酒，酒裡面的酒精成分是一種抗菌劑，有助於傷口的癒合。

lines.en: And that wine, as you take it at communion, or the juice that may be served in your church, stands for the blood of Christ.
lines.zh: 而那酒，就像你在聖餐時領受的，或者你們教會可能提供的葡萄汁一樣，代表著基督的寶血。

lines.en: And the Bible says, "The blood of Jesus Christ, God's Son, cleanseth from all sin."
lines.zh: 聖經上說：「祂兒子耶穌的血也洗淨我們一切的罪。」

lines.en: God doesn't just change us and convert us, and give us eternal life—God keeps us!
lines.zh: 神不只是改變我們、使我們悔改歸主，並賜給我們永生——神還保守我們！

lines.en: And brought him up, the Scripture says, "to an inn and took care of him."
lines.zh: 「把他帶去，」經上說：「到客店裡去，照應他。」

lines.en: And Peter said, "Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation."
lines.zh: 彼得說：「你們這因信蒙神能力保守的人，必能得著所預備......的救恩。」

lines.en: You don't have to hold on and stay in the Kingdom of God by holding on.
lines.zh: 你不需要靠著自己苦苦抓牢來留在神的國裡。

lines.en: He holds you!
lines.zh: 是祂抓住了你！

lines.en: He takes care of you!
lines.zh: 祂會照顧你！

lines.en: He put him on his own beast. He had his own ambulance right there.
lines.zh: 他把他扶上自己的牲口。他就在那裡有了自己的救護車。

lines.en: And so Christ will put you in a place and give you a peace and a joy.
lines.zh: 因此，基督也會把你安置在一個地方，賜給你平安和喜樂。

lines.en: That was the first Samaritan hospital in history right there.
lines.zh: 那正是歷史上第一家撒馬利亞人醫院。

lines.en: The psalmist said concerning Christ, "He brought me up."
lines.zh: 詩篇作者論到基督時說：「祂把我拉上來。」

lines.en: It says, "He set me up, He set my feet on a rock."
lines.zh: 經上說：「祂把我安置好，使我的腳立在磐石上。」

lines.en: He held me up, He tunes me up, He'll catch me up someday.
lines.zh: 祂扶持我，祂調整我，總有一天祂會把我接上去。

lines.en: And on the day after when he left, he paid the price and said, "If he has any more needs, I'll pay when I come back."
lines.zh: 而第二天他離開時，他付了錢並說：「如果他還有什麼需要，我回來時會還你。」

lines.en: Jesus Christ is coming.
lines.zh: 耶穌基督即將再來。

lessons.title: The Good Samaritan
lessons.summaryZh: 葛理翰牧師呼召會眾公開決志接受耶穌，並邀請電視機前的觀眾一同回應。

lines.en: Christ can touch your life and make you new and give you eternal life.
lines.zh: 基督能觸摸你的生命，使你成為新造的人，並賜給你永生。

lines.en: And then you'll have the strength and the ability to go out and be a neighbor to those that you should be a neighbor to.
lines.zh: 然後你就會有力量和能力走出去，成為那些你理當成為其鄰舍之人的鄰舍。

lines.en: You say, "What do I have to do?"
lines.zh: 你會問：「我必須做什麼呢？」

lines.en: You have to say, "God, I'm sorry I've sinned.
lines.zh: 你必須說：「神啊，我為我犯了罪感到抱歉。

lines.en: Lord, I'm willing to change my way of life.
lines.zh: 主啊，我願意改變我的生活方式。

lines.en: Lord, I receive You into my heart by faith, and I do it openly."
lines.zh: 主啊，我憑著信心接待祢進入我的心，並且我是公開地這麼做。」

lines.en: Every person Jesus called, He called openly and publicly in the New Testament.
lines.zh: 在新約聖經中，耶穌所呼召的每一個人，祂都是公開且在眾人面前呼召的。

lines.en: That's the reason I'm going to ask you to get up right now and come forward, and stand in front of the platform.
lines.zh: 這就是為什麼我現在要請你站起來，走到前面，站在講台前。

lines.en: I want you to get up and come and stand and say tonight, "I want eternal life.
lines.zh: 我希望你今晚站起來，走上前來站著說：「我想要永生。

lines.en: I want my sins forgiven.
lines.zh: 我要我的罪得赦免。

lines.en: I want to know I'm going to heaven.
lines.zh: 我想確知我會上天堂。

lines.en: I want Christ in my heart.
lines.zh: 我要基督住在我心裡。

lines.en: I want a new relationship with Him."
lines.zh: 我想與祂建立全新的關係。」

lines.en: You get up and come right now, we're going to wait.
lines.zh: 你現在就站起來走上前，我們會等你。

lines.en: Just as I am, and waiting not to rid my soul of one dark blot.
lines.zh: 照我本相，無善足稱，不待洗淨哪怕一處的黑斑。

lines.en: As hundreds are responding to Mr. Graham's invitation to make a public commitment to Jesus Christ, you can make that same commitment right where you are.
lines.zh: 當數百人正在回應葛理翰先生的呼召，公開決志信靠耶穌基督時，你在你所在之處也可以做同樣的決志。

lines.en: Just pick up the phone and call the number you see on your screen.
lines.zh: 只要拿起電話，撥打你螢幕上看到的號碼。

lines.en: Special friends are waiting to talk with you and pray with you about this most important decision.
lines.zh: 有特別的朋友正等著與你交談，為你這個最重要的決定與你一起禱告。

lines.en: I come, I come.
lines.zh: 我來，我來。

lines.en: You that have been watching by television can see that scores of people are coming from every part of this great stadium to make their commitment to Jesus Christ.
lines.zh: 你們在電視機前觀看的人可以看到，有許多人正從這個大體育場的各個角落走過來，決志信靠耶穌基督。

lines.en: And where you are: in a living room, in a hotel room, in a bar, wherever, you can make that same commitment to Christ.
lines.zh: 無論你身在何處：在客廳、在飯店房間、在酒吧，無論哪裡，你都可以向基督做同樣的決志。

lines.en: God help you to make that commitment.
lines.zh: 願神幫助你做出那個決志。

lines.en: And be sure and go to church next Sunday.
lines.zh: 並且務必在下個星期天去教會。

lines.en: God bless you.
lines.zh: 願神賜福給你。

lines.en: If you just prayed that prayer with my father, or if you have any questions about a relationship with Jesus Christ, why don't you call the number on the screen.
lines.zh: 如果你剛才跟我的父親一起作了那個禱告，或者你對與耶穌基督的關係有任何疑問，何不撥打螢幕上的號碼呢？

lines.en: There will be someone there to talk with you, pray with you and answer those questions.
lines.zh: 會有專人在那裡與你交談、陪你禱告，並回答那些問題。

lines.en: And remember, God loves you!
lines.zh: 並且記住，神愛你！

lines.en: If you would like to commit your life to Jesus Christ, please call us right now, toll free at 1-877-772-4559.
lines.zh: 如果你願意將你的生命交託給耶穌基督，請現在就打電話給我們，免付費專線 1-877-772-4559。

lines.en: Or you can write to us at: Billy Graham, 1 Billy Graham Parkway, Department C, Charlotte, NC 28201.
lines.zh: 或者你可以寫信給我們，地址是：Billy Graham, 1 Billy Graham Parkway, Department C, Charlotte, NC 28201。

lines.en: Or you can contact us on the web 24/7 at peacewithgod.tv.
lines.zh: 或者你可以全天候 24 小時在 peacewithgod.tv 網站上聯絡我們。

lines.en: We'll get the same helps to you that we give to everyone who responds at the invitation.
lines.zh: 我們會提供給所有回應呼召的人同樣的幫助。

lines.en: On behalf of Franklin Graham and the Billy Graham Evangelistic Association, thank you for watching and thank you for your prayers.
lines.zh: 代表葛福臨以及葛理翰佈道大會，感謝您的收看，也感謝您的代禱。

lines.en: It’s Anne, she’s in trouble.
lines.zh: 是安妮，她惹上麻煩了。

lines.en: If you don’t take it to the edge every chance you get, you’re dead already, baby.
lines.zh: 如果你不抓住每個機會挑戰極限，你就已經死了，寶貝。

lines.en: I was in trouble and I didn’t know what to do.
lines.zh: 我遇到了麻煩，不知道該怎麼辦。

lines.en: "Ow!"
lines.zh: 「哎喲！」

lines.en: Where are the Jews?
lines.zh: 猶太人在哪裡？

lines.en: I knew that I could take on the world.
lines.zh: 我知道我可以挑戰全世界。

lines.en: It’s like you’re in a dream, but not really a dream, this is reality.
lines.zh: 這就像你身在夢中，但又不是真的夢，這是現實。

lines.en: I don’t really believe in all this but I know something crazy is happening right now.
lines.zh: 我並不是真的相信這一切，但我知道現在正發生一些瘋狂的事。

lessons.title: A Cure for Heart Trouble
lessons.summaryZh: 人心是情感、行動與信仰的中心，在神眼中這才是最重要的。

lines.en: Now tonight I want you to turn with me to the 22nd chapter of Matthew's gospel.
lines.zh: 今天晚上，我想請你們和我一起翻到《馬太福音》第二十二章。

lines.en: And I want to speak on the subject, "A Cure for Heart Trouble."
lines.zh: 我想講的主題是「心病的解藥」。

lines.en: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him and saying, "Master, which is the great commandment in the law?"
lines.zh: 「內中有一個人是律法師，要試探耶穌，就問祂說：『夫子，律法上的誡命，哪一條是最大的呢？』」

lines.en: And Jesus said unto him, "Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul and with all thy mind."
lines.zh: 「耶穌對他說：『你要盡心、盡性、盡意愛主你的神。』」

lines.en: "This is the first and the great commandment, and the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself."
lines.zh: 「這是誡命中第一，且是最大的。其次也相倣，就是要愛人如己。」

lines.en: "On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets."
lines.zh: 「這兩條誡命是律法和先知一切道理的總綱。」

lines.en: Think of it.
lines.zh: 想一想。

lines.en: All the law and all the prophets hang on these two commandments.
lines.zh: 所有的律法和先知一切的道理，都繫於這兩條誡命上。

lines.en: I want to give you the scripture text again so you can memorize it.
lines.zh: 我想再給你們一次經文，讓你們可以背下來。

lines.en: It's Matthew 22 and 37, 38, 39 and 40.
lines.zh: 是《馬太福音》二十二章37、38、39和40節。

lines.en: And it's no mistake that Jesus made.
lines.zh: 耶穌這樣說絕非錯誤。

lines.en: He did it deliberately.
lines.zh: 祂是刻意這麼做的。

lines.en: He listed the heart first.
lines.zh: 祂把「心」列在第一位。

lines.en: "Love the Lord thy God with all thy heart and all thy soul and all thy strength."
lines.zh: 「要盡心、盡性、盡力愛主你的神。」

lines.en: You know, here in Syracuse, as you enter the city on I-690 there's a huge billboard announcing that Syracuse is the heart of New York State, and I believe it is.
lines.zh: 你們知道，在雪城這裡，當你們從 I-690 公路進入這座城市時，有一塊巨大的廣告牌宣稱雪城是紐約州的心臟，我相信確實如此。

lines.en: It's the heart of New York State, and President Roosevelt, Franklin Roosevelt and elder Roosevelt were associated worldwide with central New York.
lines.zh: 它是紐約州的心臟，而羅斯福總統——富蘭克林·羅斯福和老羅斯福，在全世界都與紐約州中部聯繫在一起。

lines.en: And Bernard Baruch, who was one of the great philosophers and advisor to six presidents and one of the most brilliant Jewish leaders in the country and a friend to me, once was asked by Eleanor Roosevelt who said,
lines.zh: 而伯納德·巴魯克，他是一位偉大的哲學家、六位總統的顧問、美國最傑出的猶太領袖之一，也是我的朋友，有一次艾蓮娜·羅斯福問他：

lines.en: "If my head says one thing and my heart another, which should I follow?"
lines.zh: 「如果我的理智說一回事，而我的心說另一回事，我該聽從哪一個？」

lines.en: And Bernard Baruch said to Mrs. Roosevelt, "Follow your heart."
lines.zh: 伯納德·巴魯克對羅斯福夫人說：「聽從妳的心。」

lines.en: You see, your heart is the center of your life.
lines.zh: 你看，你的心是你生命的中心。

lines.en: You know, if you think about your heart, your physical heart, it beats a hundred thousand strokes every twenty-four hours.
lines.zh: 你知道，如果你想想你的心臟，你肉體的心臟，它每二十四小時跳動十萬次。

lines.en: It contracts four thousand times an hour.
lines.zh: 它每小時收縮四千次。

lines.en: Our blood weighs about twenty-five pounds and all of it passes through the heart every four minutes.
lines.zh: 我們的血液重約二十五磅，所有的血液每四分鐘就會流經心臟一次。

lines.en: In Proverbs 23:7 the Scripture says, "As a man thinketh in his heart, so is he."
lines.zh: 在《箴言》二十三章7節，經文說：「因為他心怎樣思量，他為人就是怎樣。」

lines.en: And the heart is used throughout the Bible, considered far more than a bodily organ.
lines.zh: 而在整本聖經中都有提到「心」，它被認為遠不止是一個身體器官。

lines.en: It's the seat of our emotions.
lines.zh: 它是我們情感的中心。

lines.en: As boys, I remember we used to write our initials on trees, or on the side of some barn our girlfriend's name and a picture of the heart.
lines.zh: 我記得小時候，我們常在樹上刻下自己名字的首字母，或者在穀倉旁邊寫下女朋友的名字，並畫一顆心。

lines.en: Valentine's Day is a day for sweethearts and the symbol is a heart.
lines.zh: 情人節是情侶的節日，而其象徵就是一顆心。

lines.en: When we become frightened or excited, we put our hands over our hearts.
lines.zh: 當我們感到害怕或興奮時，我們會把手放在心上。

lines.en: It's the center of our emotions.
lines.zh: 它是我們情感的中心。

lines.en: When we salute the flag, like we did the other day at the Rotary Club, when they were saluting the flag and singing the Star-Spangled Banner, we put our hands over our hearts.
lines.zh: 當我們向國旗致敬時，就像我們前幾天在扶輪社那樣，當他們向國旗致敬並唱《星條旗》時，我們把手放在心上。

lines.en: Or saying some of the great patriotic things, we put our hands over our hearts.
lines.zh: 或者在說一些偉大的愛國宣言時，我們把手放在心上。

lines.en: The heart is also the seat of decisive action.
lines.zh: 心也是決定性行動的中心。

lines.en: The Bible says, "The fool hath said," not in his mind, but "in his heart, there is no God."
lines.zh: 聖經說：「愚頑人說，」不是在他腦海裡，而是「在他心裡說，沒有神。」

lines.en: And the scripture says in Proverbs 4, "Keep thy heart with all diligence, for out of it are the issues of life."
lines.zh: 而經文在《箴言》四章說：「你要保守你心，勝過保守一切，因為一生的果效是由心發出。」

lines.en: The heart is the seat of belief as well as the basis of doubt.
lines.zh: 心是信仰的中心，也是懷疑的基礎。

lines.en: Christ said, "For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts and murders and adulteries and fornications and thefts and false witnesses and blasphemies."
lines.zh: 基督說：「因為從心裡發出來的，有惡念、凶殺、姦淫、苟合、偷盜、妄證、謗讟。」

lines.en: But you have something wrong with your heart, and I have something wrong with my heart.
lines.zh: 但是你的心出了問題，我的心也出了問題。

lines.en: Our hearts are diseased by a disease the Bible calls sin.
lines.zh: 我們的心患了一種聖經稱之為「罪」的疾病。

lines.en: You see, the heart is also the seat of life.
lines.zh: 你看，心也是生命的中心。

lines.en: The Bible says your heart will live forever.
lines.zh: 聖經說，你的心將永遠活著。

lines.en: Think of it, your body is going to die and go to the grave, but your heart, your soul, your spirit, will live forever.
lines.zh: 想一想，你的身體會死亡並進入墳墓，但你的心、你的靈魂、你的靈，將永遠活著。

lines.en: A thousand years from tonight it will still be alive.
lines.zh: 從今晚起一千年後，它依然活著。

lines.en: When God looks at man, He doesn't look at the color of his skin, the kind of clothes he wears, or his social position.
lines.zh: 當神看人時，祂不看人的膚色、穿著打扮，或社會地位。

lines.en: The Bible says out of the heart of a black person or an oriental person or a white man or woman, out of the heart are the issues of life.
lines.zh: 聖經說，無論是黑人、東方人、白人男性或女性的心，一生的果效都是由心發出。

lines.en: And no physician on earth can tell one from the other.
lines.zh: 世界上沒有任何醫生能分辨它們的差別。

lines.en: We're all alike in the sight of God.
lines.zh: 在神眼中我們都是一樣的。

lines.en: The Bible says, "Man looks on the outward appearance, but God looks upon the heart."
lines.zh: 聖經說：「人是看外貌，耶和華是看內心。」

lines.en: And in the scriptures, the heart is considered the symbol of the entire person.
lines.zh: 在聖經中，心被視為整個人的象徵。

lines.en: When Steven of Colona fell into the hands of his assailants and they asked him in derision, "Wherein now is your fortress?"
lines.zh: 當科隆納的斯蒂芬落入襲擊者手中，他們嘲笑著問他：「現在你的堡壘在哪裡？」

lines.en: Steven placed his hand over his heart and said, "Here is my fortress."
lines.zh: 斯蒂芬把手放在心上，說：「這裡就是我的堡壘。」

lines.en: Helen Keller, who was blind and deaf and dumb, wrote, "The best and most wonderful things in the world cannot be seen or touched but are just felt in the heart."
lines.zh: 集盲、聾、啞於一身的海倫·凱勒寫道：「世界上最美好、最奇妙的事物是看不見也摸不著的，只能用心去感受。」

lines.en: You see, the heart has come to stand for the moral, spiritual and intellectual life of a person.
lines.zh: 你看，心已經成為一個人道德、屬靈和理智生活的代表。

lines.en: It's the seat of a person's conscience and life and extremely important.
lines.zh: 它是一個人良知和生命的中心，極其重要。

lines.en: And the question I want to ask you tonight is this: "Is your heart right?"
lines.zh: 而今晚我想問你們的問題是：「你的心對了嗎？」

lines.en: Is your heart right, is it right with God?
lines.zh: 你的心對了嗎？它在神面前是對的嗎？

lines.en: Because if it's not right with God, your sins are not forgiven.
lines.zh: 因為如果它在神面前不對，你的罪就沒有得到赦免。

lines.en: You're not going to heaven when you die.
lines.zh: 你死後也進不了天堂。

lines.en: Our hearts have to be right.
lines.zh: 我們的心必須是對的。

lines.en: I do not ask about your outward life.
lines.zh: 我不問你外在的生活。

lines.en: I don't ask about your intellectual life or your financial status or your social life.
lines.zh: 我不問你的理智生活、財務狀況，或社交生活。

lines.en: I'm asking about your heart.
lines.zh: 我問的是你的心。

lines.en: What about your heart?
lines.zh: 你的心如何呢？

lessons.title: A Cure for Heart Trouble
lessons.summaryZh: 聖經指出人心充滿了各樣邪惡與詭詐，因不認識神而昏昧剛硬。

lines.en: Dig deep into your heart tonight in your thinking.
lines.zh: 今晚在你的思想中，深深地挖掘你的內心。

lines.en: How are you toward God?
lines.zh: 你對神的態度如何？

lines.en: Are you right with God?
lines.zh: 你與神的關係對嗎？

lines.en: The Bible says, "Prepare to meet thy God."
lines.zh: 聖經說：「你當預備迎見你的神」。

lines.en: And before you can prepare to meet God, your heart has to be right and your heart has to be touched by the Holy Spirit.
lines.zh: 在你預備迎見神之前，你的心必須是對的，你的心必須被聖靈觸摸。

lines.en: Now what does the Bible teach about the heart?
lines.zh: 那麼，聖經對人心有什麼教導呢？

lines.en: The Bible teaches that our hearts are sinful.
lines.zh: 聖經教導我們，我們的心是有罪的。

lines.en: They're sinful.
lines.zh: 它們是有罪的。

lines.en: Mine is, yours is.
lines.zh: 我的心是，你的心也是。

lines.en: We're born with it from Adam and Eve.
lines.zh: 我們從亞當和夏娃那裡生來就帶著罪。

lines.en: It's passed on from generation to generation.
lines.zh: 這罪代代相傳。

lines.en: And the Bible says, first of all, that our hearts are full of evil imagination.
lines.zh: 聖經首先說，我們的心充滿了邪惡的想像。

lines.en: Proverbs 6:18, "A heart that deviseth wicked imagination."
lines.zh: 箴言 6:18：「圖謀惡計的心」。

lines.en: What do you imagine?
lines.zh: 你在想像什麼？

lines.en: What are your fantasies?
lines.zh: 你的幻想是什麼？

lines.en: What do you fantasize about?
lines.zh: 你幻想些什麼？

lines.en: And then secondly, the Bible says the heart is desperately wicked and deceitful.
lines.zh: 其次，聖經說人心是極其邪惡和詭詐的。

lines.en: Jeremiah 17:9, "The heart is deceitful above all things and desperately wicked.
lines.zh: 耶利米書 17:9：「人心比萬物都詭詐，壞到極處。

lines.en: Who can know it?"
lines.zh: 誰能識透呢？」

lines.en: That's your heart.
lines.zh: 這就是你的心。

lines.en: That's what the Bible thinks of your heart.
lines.zh: 這就是聖經對你內心的看法。

lines.en: That's what God thinks about your heart and my heart.
lines.zh: 這就是神對你我內心的看法。

lines.en: The Bible says the heart is far from God in Matthew 15.
lines.zh: 馬太福音第十五章中，聖經說人心遠離神。

lines.en: "This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth and honoreth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me."
lines.zh: 「這百姓用嘴唇尊敬我，心卻遠離我。」

lines.en: How many of us go to church and sing?
lines.zh: 我們當中有多少人去教會唱歌？

lines.en: How many of us go to church and listen to the clergyman?
lines.zh: 我們當中有多少人去教會聽牧職人員講道？

lines.en: How many of us outwardly live a fairly good life, but our heart is far from God?
lines.zh: 我們當中有多少人外表上過著相當不錯的生活，但我們的心卻遠離神？

lines.en: We don't have that experience with Christ in which He's in our hearts all day long.
lines.zh: 我們沒有與基督的那種經歷，就是祂整天都在我們心裡。

lines.en: And we think about Him and pray to Him and He's close to us, but He should be.
lines.zh: 我們思想祂，向祂禱告，而且祂親近我們——但祂本該如此親近我們。

lines.en: And we're not bearing in our bodies and in our lives the fruit of the Spirit which is love and joy and peace, and gentleness, faithfulness.
lines.zh: 我們在我們的身體和生活中也沒有結出聖靈的果子，就是仁愛、喜樂、和平、溫柔、信實。

lines.en: And then the Bible says that our hearts are a treasury of evil.
lines.zh: 然後聖經說，我們的心是邪惡的寶庫。

lines.en: Mark 7, Jesus said, "For within, out of the heart proceed evil thoughts."
lines.zh: 馬可福音第七章，耶穌說：「因為從裡面，就是從人心裡，發出惡念。」

lines.en: Evil thoughts come from the heart.
lines.zh: 惡念從心裡發出。

lines.en: Adultery.
lines.zh: 姦淫。

lines.en: You might commit adultery with your body, but it starts in the heart and in the mind.
lines.zh: 你可能用身體犯了姦淫，但它是從內心和思想開始的。

lines.en: And fornications, and murders and thefts, and covetousness and wickedness and deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride and foolishness.
lines.zh: 還有苟合、凶殺、偷盜、貪婪、邪惡、詭詐、淫蕩、嫉妒、謗讟、驕傲、狂妄。

lines.en: All these things the Bible said, Jesus said, come from the heart.
lines.zh: 聖經說，耶穌說，這一切事都是從心裡發出來的。

lines.en: So, the most important thing in the world for you tonight is to be sure that your heart is right with God and that you have been forgiven of all those things.
lines.zh: 所以，今晚對你來說世上最重要的事情，就是確定你的心在神面前是對的，並且你這一切的罪都已被赦免。

lines.en: And how many today have darkened hearts?
lines.zh: 今天有多少人的心是昏昧的？

lines.en: I'm sometimes absolutely amazed at their ignorance of the world and their ignorance comes from the fact that they don't know God.
lines.zh: 我有時對他們對這個世界的無知感到絕對地驚訝，而他們的無知來自於他們不認識神這個事實。

lines.en: They don't know the Bible.
lines.zh: 他們不認識聖經。

lines.en: They don't know God's plan for the ages and so they make so many mistakes because their heart is dark, and Satan has blinded their eyes.
lines.zh: 他們不知道神歷代的計畫，所以他們犯了那麼多錯誤，因為他們的心是黑暗的，撒但蒙蔽了他們的眼睛。

lines.en: And many times, I've talked to many people who have very little education, but they know God.
lines.zh: 很多時候，我和許多沒受過什麼教育的人交談，但他們認識神。

lines.en: And they know more about what's wrong and how to right it than those people with all the brilliant education.
lines.zh: 他們比那些受過優良教育的人更懂得什麼是錯的，以及如何去糾正它。

lines.en: You see, there's something wrong with us that we don't recognize in the world in which we live.
lines.zh: 你看，我們身上出了些問題，而在我們所處的世界裡我們卻沒有察覺。

lines.en: Our world is secular.
lines.zh: 我們的世界是世俗的。

lines.en: Our world doesn't want to take into account that God exists or that man is made in the image of God.
lines.zh: 我們的世界不願把神的存在考慮進去，也不願承認人是按著神的形像造的。

lines.en: His heart is made in God's image and made for fellowship with God, and without God it's dark.
lines.zh: 他的心是按著神的形像造的，是為了與神相交而造的，沒有神，心就是黑暗的。

lines.en: You see, the devil darkens our understanding.
lines.zh: 你看，魔鬼使我們的悟性昏昧。

lines.en: Sin darkens our understanding.
lines.zh: 罪使我們的悟性昏昧。

lines.en: Sin paralyzes our will.
lines.zh: 罪麻痺了我們的意志。

lines.en: Dulls the conscience and defiles the heart.
lines.zh: 遲鈍了良心，污穢了內心。

lines.en: And then the Bible says we have unbelieving hearts.
lines.zh: 然後聖經說我們有不信的心。

lines.en: "Take heed, brethren, lest there be any among you with an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God," Hebrews, the third chapter.
lines.zh: 「弟兄們，你們要謹慎，免得你們中間或有人存著不信的惡心，把永生神離棄了。」希伯來書第三章。

lines.en: And then our hearts are blind.
lines.zh: 然後我們的心是瞎眼的。

lines.en: Ephesians 4, "Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them because of the blindness of their heart."
lines.zh: 以弗所書第四章：「他們心地昏昧，與神所賜的生命隔絕了，都因自己無知，心裡剛硬。」

lessons.title: A Cure for Heart Trouble
lessons.summaryZh: 我們的心常被驕傲與偶像蒙蔽，唯有神能除掉我們剛硬的石心。

lines.en: Our hearts are blind.
lines.zh: 我們的心是盲目的。

lines.en: Would you like to have your heart illuminated by the Spirit of God?
lines.zh: 你想要讓神的靈光照你的心嗎？

lines.en: And then the Bible says our hearts are deceitful.
lines.zh: 接著聖經說，我們的心是詭詐的。

lines.en: The heart is deceitful above all things.
lines.zh: 人心比萬物都詭詐。

lines.en: Think of it.
lines.zh: 想想看。

lines.en: Above all things your heart is deceitful.
lines.zh: 你們的心比萬物都詭詐。

lines.en: It deceives you.
lines.zh: 它欺騙你。

lines.en: It deceives other people.
lines.zh: 它欺騙別人。

lines.en: And then in Psalm 101 it says that our hearts are proud.
lines.zh: 然後在《詩篇》第一百零一篇說，我們的心是驕傲的。

lines.en: "Him that hath a high look and a proud heart, I'll not recognize," says God.
lines.zh: 神說：「眼目高傲、心裡驕縱的，我必不容他。」

lines.en: Then the Bible says our hearts are rebellious.
lines.zh: 然後聖經說我們的心是悖逆的。

lines.en: "But this people hath a revolting and rebellious heart.
lines.zh: 「但這百姓有背叛忤逆的心，

lines.en: "They're revolted and gone."
lines.zh: 他們叛我而去。」

lines.en: The Bible says that our hearts are idolatrous.
lines.zh: 聖經說我們的心充滿偶像。

lines.en: We think of other things more than we think of God.
lines.zh: 我們想別的事比想神還要多。

lines.en: And anything that you think more of than you do of God becomes idolatry.
lines.zh: 任何你認為比神更重要的事物，就成了偶像崇拜。

lines.en: It may be that box in the corner in your room that we call television.
lines.zh: 可能是你房間角落裡那個我們稱為電視的盒子。

lines.en: And you spend more time in television than you do in the Bible.
lines.zh: 你花在電視上的時間比花在聖經上的時間還多。

lines.en: More time thinking about what you've seen on the television than you do in the Bible.
lines.zh: 花更多時間去想你在電視上看到的，而不是聖經裡的內容。

lines.en: And sometimes I have to get down on my knees and confess that I've done the same thing.
lines.zh: 有時候我必須雙膝跪下，承認我也做了同樣的事。

lines.en: And I say, "O God, cleanse me and forgive me.
lines.zh: 我說：「神啊，求祢潔淨我、赦免我。

lines.en: "I've spent too much time in front of that screen tonight.
lines.zh: 「今晚我在那螢幕前花太多時間了。

lines.en: "I should have been reading and soaking up Your word and spending time in prayer for people in Africa,
lines.zh: 「我本來應該閱讀、吸收祢的話語，並花時間為非洲的人代禱，

lines.en: "and people in other parts of the world where there's so much hunger and so much homelessness and so much suffering."
lines.zh: 「以及世界其他地方那些面臨極大飢荒、無家可歸和苦難的人們代禱。」

lines.en: And then the Bible says our hearts are stony.
lines.zh: 接著聖經說我們的心是石心。

lines.en: "And I will take the stony heart out of their flesh."
lines.zh: 「我又要從他們肉體中除掉石心。」

lines.en: The Bible says our hearts are stony, hard, cold and barren.
lines.zh: 聖經說我們的心是如石頭般剛硬、冰冷且荒蕪的。

lines.en: That's your heart.
lines.zh: 那就是你的心。

lines.en: That's what the Bible says.
lines.zh: 聖經是這樣說的。

lines.en: That's how God diagnoses your heart.
lines.zh: 神就是這樣診斷你的心的。

lines.en: You go to a cardiologist to get diagnosed and he puts instruments on you, gives you a stress test or whatever.
lines.zh: 你去心臟科醫師那裡做診斷，他在你身上裝儀器，給你做壓力測試什麼的。

lines.en: Or you take a cardiogram or take an angiogram.
lines.zh: 或是做心電圖、血管攝影。

lines.en: I remember the first time I had an angiogram at the Mayo Clinic in Rochester, Minnesota.
lines.zh: 我記得第一次在明尼蘇達州羅徹斯特的梅奧診所做血管攝影時，

lines.en: I was a little bit nervous about it, and I lay there and I said to the doctor—there were several doctors—I said,
lines.zh: 我有點緊張，我躺在那裡，對醫生說——那裡有好幾位醫生——我說：

lines.en: "When are you going to insert that tube and put that dye in my heart?" because they had a big screen up there.
lines.zh: 「你們什麼時候要插入管子，把顯影劑打進我的心臟？」因為上面有一個大螢幕。

lines.en: He said, "It's already in. Look up there."
lines.zh: 他說：「已經進去了。你看上面。」

lines.en: I didn't even know it when they did it.
lines.zh: 他們做的時候我甚至都沒感覺。

lines.en: And I'd been told by people, "Oh my," and they had me nervous about it.
lines.zh: 之前有人告訴我：「我的天啊！」他們讓我對此感到很緊張。

lines.en: The Bible also says that our hearts can be hardened.
lines.zh: 聖經也說我們的心可能會變得剛硬。

lines.en: You see, Pharaoh, I was watching a little bit of The Ten Commandments the other night when I was home.
lines.zh: 你看，法老——前幾天晚上我在家時看了一點《十誡》這部電影。

lines.en: They had it running on one of the stations.
lines.zh: 當時有個電視台正在播。

lines.en: And how Pharaoh hardened his heart.
lines.zh: 而法老是如何使他的心剛硬的。

lines.en: In Exodus 7 it says, "And the Lord said unto Moses, Pharaoh's heart is hard; he refuses to let the people go."
lines.zh: 在《出埃及記》第七章說：「耶和華對摩西說：法老心裡剛硬，不肯容百姓去。」

lines.en: God sent ten plagues to soften Pharaoh up, and he promised every time he'd let the people of Israel leave Egypt.
lines.zh: 神降下十災來軟化法老，而他每一次都答應會讓以色列人離開埃及。

lines.en: They were slaves in Egypt.
lines.zh: 他們在埃及是奴隸。

lessons.title: A Cure for Heart Trouble
lessons.summaryZh: 我們若硬著心必走向滅亡；但神會衡量人心，並藉聖靈與寶血來預備、開啟，賜給我們新心。

lines.en: But he didn't do it.
lines.zh: 但他沒有這麼做。

lines.en: He broke his promise every time and he hardened his heart.
lines.zh: 他每一次都違背諾言，並且硬著心。

lines.en: And let me tell you something.
lines.zh: 讓我告訴你一件事。

lines.en: The Bible says, "He that hardeneth his heart, being often reproved, shall suddenly be cut off and that without remedy."
lines.zh: 聖經說：「人屢次受責罰，仍然硬著頸項；他必頃刻敗壞，無法可治。」

lines.en: In other words, there will come the last time that you harden your heart and it will all be over.
lines.zh: 換句話說，總會有最後一次你硬著心，然後一切就結束了。

lines.en: There will be no more chance for you.
lines.zh: 你不會再有機會了。

lines.en: Because, you see, when you harden your heart, it builds a little ring around it.
lines.zh: 因為你看，當你硬著心的時候，心裡就會結出一層硬殼。

lines.en: And the Holy Spirit may speak to you again, but your heart will be harder.
lines.zh: 聖靈可能再次對你說話，但你的心會變得更硬。

lines.en: It will be like Pharaoh's heart getting harder and harder every time,
lines.zh: 這就像法老的心每一次都變得越來越硬，

lines.en: until when God speaks to you, you can no longer hear Him.
lines.zh: 直到當神對你說話時，你再也聽不見祂。

lines.en: What about you?
lines.zh: 那你呢？

lines.en: Is your heart right?
lines.zh: 你的心對了嗎？

lines.en: God takes our heart out and ponders it.
lines.zh: 神把我們的心拿出來，並且衡量它。

lines.en: Think of the Almighty God studying your heart.
lines.zh: 想像一下全能的神在審視你的心。

lines.en: "Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the Lord pondereth the heart." Proverbs 21:2.
lines.zh: 「人所行的，在自己眼中都看為正；惟有耶和華衡量人心。」箴言二十一章2節。

lines.en: The scripture says, "If thou sayest, Behold we know it not;
lines.zh: 聖經說：「你若說：這事我未曾知道，

lines.en: doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it,
lines.zh: 那衡量人心的豈不明白嗎？

lines.en: and he that keepeth thy soul, doeth he not know it,
lines.zh: 保守你命的豈不知道嗎？

lines.en: and shall not he render to every man according to his works?"
lines.zh: 祂豈不按各人所行的報應各人嗎？」

lines.en: He knows your heart.
lines.zh: 祂知道你的心。

lines.en: He studies it.
lines.zh: 祂審視它。

lines.en: You can't fool Him.
lines.zh: 你無法欺瞞祂。

lines.en: You can't hide.
lines.zh: 你無處躲藏。

lines.en: He knows all the secrets.
lines.zh: 祂知道所有的秘密。

lines.en: How do you stand before God?
lines.zh: 你在神面前站立得住嗎？

lines.en: Is your heart right with God?
lines.zh: 你的心在神面前端正嗎？

lines.en: Then the Bible says He weighs the heart and tries the heart.
lines.zh: 然後聖經說，祂衡量人心，試驗人心。

lines.en: What do you mean He weighs the heart?
lines.zh: 祂衡量人心是什麼意思？

lines.en: Well, He weighs your heart by the Ten Commandments.
lines.zh: 嗯，祂用十誡來衡量你的心。

lines.en: He weighs it by the Sermon on the Mount.
lines.zh: 祂用登山寶訓來衡量它。

lines.en: He weighs it by the great law that we just read.
lines.zh: 祂用我們剛才讀的偉大律法來衡量它。

lines.en: He weighs it by the life of Christ.
lines.zh: 祂用基督的生平來衡量它。

lines.en: He weighs it by the teachings of Scripture on the way we ought to live.
lines.zh: 祂用聖經中關於我們應當如何生活的教導來衡量它。

lines.en: He weighs your heart.
lines.zh: 祂衡量你的心。

lines.en: How much do you weigh?
lines.zh: 你秤起來有多重？

lines.en: But there's something else.
lines.zh: 但還有一件事。

lines.en: All the way through the scriptures we read about the blood of Jesus Christ.
lines.zh: 縱觀整本聖經，我們都讀到關於耶穌基督的寶血。

lines.en: Somebody said, "Don't you think that the scriptures have too much about blood?"
lines.zh: 有人說：「你不覺得聖經裡講了太多關於血的事嗎？」

lines.en: Some have called it a slaughterhouse religion.
lines.zh: 有些人稱之為屠宰場宗教。

lines.en: There is a lot about blood in the scriptures.
lines.zh: 聖經裡確實有很多關於血的記載。

lines.en: But the Bible says without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness of sins.
lines.zh: 但聖經說，若不流血，罪就不得赦免了。

lines.en: If Jesus Christ had not died on that cross and shed His blood for you,
lines.zh: 如果耶穌基督沒有死在那十字架上為你流血，

lines.en: there's no way you could be forgiven of your sins.
lines.zh: 你的罪就絕不可能得到赦免。

lines.en: It means that His heart bled and it is only through the cleansing of that blood that we can be forgiven.
lines.zh: 這意味著祂的心流血了，而且只有透過那寶血的潔淨，我們才能得赦免。

lines.en: And then the Bible says God prepares the heart by the Holy Spirit.
lines.zh: 然後聖經說，神藉著聖靈預備人心。

lines.en: He prepares your heart.
lines.zh: 祂預備你的心。

lines.en: Your heart's already been prepared for this meeting tonight.
lines.zh: 為了今晚的這個聚會，你的心已經被預備好了。

lines.en: He prepares for the many experiences in your life.
lines.zh: 祂為你生命中的許多經歷做預備。

lines.en: The Bible says the preparations of the heart in man are from the Lord.
lines.zh: 聖經說，人心裡的預備是出於耶穌和華。

lines.en: Many of the experiences that you thought were terrible was God preparing you.
lines.zh: 許多你以為很可怕的經歷，其實是神在預備你。

lines.en: The Bible says He opens the heart.
lines.zh: 聖經說，祂開啟人心。

lines.en: Acts 16:14, "Whose heart the Lord openeth."
lines.zh: 使徒行傳十六章14節：「主就開導她的心。」

lines.en: How wonderful for God to prepare the heart, then open the heart.
lines.zh: 神預備人心，然後開啟人心，這是何等奇妙。

lines.en: Then He enlightens.
lines.zh: 接著祂光照。

lines.en: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened.
lines.zh: 「照明你們心中的眼睛。」

lines.en: Without the enlightenment, the opening and preparation by the Holy Spirit, no one could receive Christ.
lines.zh: 若沒有聖靈的光照、開啟和預備，沒有人能接受基督。

lines.en: You see, salvation is of the Lord.
lines.zh: 你看，救恩是出於耶和華。

lines.en: We receive, but it's all of God.
lines.zh: 我們只是領受，但這全是出於神。

lines.en: He's the one who gave His Son on the cross.
lines.zh: 是祂將自己的兒子賜下在十字架上。

lines.en: He's the one who sent the Holy Spirit to convict you.
lines.zh: 是祂差遣聖靈來使你知罪。

lines.en: He's the one that made it possible for you to come here tonight so you can receive Him into your heart.
lines.zh: 是祂使你今晚能來到這裡，好讓你能將祂接待到你心裡。

lines.en: And the Bible says that He gives a new heart.
lines.zh: 聖經也說，祂賜下一顆新心。

lines.en: God says an old heart will not do.
lines.zh: 神說舊的心是不行的。

lines.en: You have to have a new one and God doesn't just patch you up.
lines.zh: 你必須有一顆新的心，而神不會只是把你修補一下。

lines.en: "A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you.
lines.zh: 「我也要賜給你們一個新心，將新靈放在你們裡面。

lines.en: I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh."
lines.zh: 又從你們的肉體中除掉石心，賜給你們肉心。」

lines.en: God says a new heart is what you need.
lines.zh: 神說你需要的是一顆新心。

lines.en: What about you?
lines.zh: 那你呢？

lines.en: Have you received this new heart from God?
lines.zh: 你從神那裡領受這顆新心了嗎？

lines.en: You say, "Now Billy, I've been baptized, I've been confirmed, and I try to live a good life.
lines.zh: 你說：「那麼比利，我已經受洗了，也堅振了，我也努力過一個好生活。

lines.en: I don't succeed, but I try.
lines.zh: 我沒有成功，但我盡力了。

lines.en: And I try to get to Sunday School once in a while and I go to church,
lines.zh: 我偶爾也盡量去主日學，我也去教會，

lines.en: or I watch on television some church service."
lines.zh: 或者我在電視上看一些教會的禮拜。」

lessons.title: A Cure for Heart Trouble
lessons.summaryZh: 我們要為罪悔改，憑信心接受基督，並勇敢走到台前公開承認祂。

lines.en: And we think that's enough.
lines.zh: 我們以為那樣就夠了。

lines.en: But it's not enough.
lines.zh: 但那是不夠的。

lines.en: Oh yes, you may be born again at the moment of confirmation, but many of you need to reconfirm your confirmation vows.
lines.zh: 沒錯，你可能在堅信禮那一刻重生了，但你們當中許多人需要重新確認你們的堅信禮誓言。

lines.en: You need to come to the Lord and say, "Lord, I haven't kept those vows."
lines.zh: 你需要來到主面前說：「主啊，我沒有遵守那些誓言。」

lines.en: "I want to re-confirm them."
lines.zh: 「我想要重新確認它們。」

lines.en: "I want to re-dedicate my life to what I promised at confirmation, or what was promised for me at baptism."
lines.zh: 「我想要將我的生命，重新奉獻給我在堅信禮上所承諾的，或是我受洗時別人為我所承諾的。」

lines.en: Many people like that.
lines.zh: 有許多像那樣的人。

lines.en: Thousands of people.
lines.zh: 幾千人。

lines.en: Whether you're what denomination.
lines.zh: 不管你是什麼宗派的。

lines.en: It makes no difference.
lines.zh: 這都無關緊要。

lines.en: A little Sunday school girl was asked which of the Beatitudes she would rather be like.
lines.zh: 有一個主日學的小女孩被問到，她最想成為「八福」中的哪一種人。

lines.en: She said, "Pure in heart."
lines.zh: 她說：「清心的人。」

lines.en: They asked why.
lines.zh: 他們問為什麼。

lines.en: She said, "Because I could obtain a pure heart, I would possess all the other good qualities that are spoken of in this chapter."
lines.zh: 她說：「因為我若能得著一顆清心，我就會擁有這章聖經裡提到的所有其他美好特質。」

lines.en: If your heart is right, the rest of you is going to be right too.
lines.zh: 如果你的心是對的，你身上的其他部分也都會是對的。

lines.en: Christ changed the pattern of living.
lines.zh: 基督改變了生活的模式。

lines.en: He said, "A good man out of the good treasures of the heart bringeth forth good things, and an evil man out of the evil treasures brings forth evil things."
lines.zh: 祂說：「善人從他心裡所存的善就發出善來；惡人從他所存的惡就發出惡來。」

lines.en: Christ said, "Except a man is born from above, he cannot see the kingdom of heaven."
lines.zh: 基督說：「人若不從上頭生，就不能見神的國。」

lines.en: How do you receive Him?
lines.zh: 你要如何接受祂呢？

lines.en: First, you must repent of sin.
lines.zh: 首先，你必須為罪悔改。

lines.en: You have to say to God, "O Lord, I've sinned."
lines.zh: 你必須對神說：「主啊，我犯了罪。」

lines.en: "I'm sorry."
lines.zh: 「我懊悔。」

lines.en: "I'm willing to change my way of living."
lines.zh: 「我願意改變我的生活方式。」

lines.en: That's repentance.
lines.zh: 那就是悔改。

lines.en: "I'm willing."
lines.zh: 「我願意。」

lines.en: Notice, you can't do it yourself.
lines.zh: 請注意，你無法靠自己做到。

lines.en: God has to help you even in the repenting.
lines.zh: 甚至在悔改這件事上，神也必須幫助你。

lines.en: And then you receive Him by faith.
lines.zh: 然後你憑著信心接受祂。

lines.en: When I stepped up on this platform the other night for the first time, I didn't stomp it, check it, to see if it had been built to hold a man.
lines.zh: 前幾天晚上我第一次踏上這個講台時，我沒有用力踩它、檢查它，看它是否堅固到能承受一個人的重量。

lines.en: I had faith in the people that put it here.
lines.zh: 我對搭建它的人有信心。

lines.en: When you sat in that seat, you didn't look it over and feel it to see if it would hold you.
lines.zh: 當你坐在那個位子上時，你沒有把椅子仔細檢查、摸一摸，看它能不能撐住你。

lines.en: You believed in the people that built it.
lines.zh: 你相信製造它的人。

lines.en: That's the same kind of faith we're talking about here.
lines.zh: 這就是我們在這裡所說的同一種信心。

lines.en: Faith in Christ.
lines.zh: 對基督的信心。

lines.en: Not in anything else except Christ, and what He did at the cross, and at the resurrection when God raised Him from the dead and He's alive.
lines.zh: 不在於別的，只在於基督，在於祂在十字架上所做的，以及在復活時，神使祂從死裡復活，並且祂現在活著。

lines.en: I'm going to ask you to do it as we saw last night more than a thousand people do.
lines.zh: 我要請你們照做，就像我們昨晚看到的一千多人那樣做。

lines.en: I'm going to ask you to get up out of your seat.
lines.zh: 我要請你們從座位上站起來。

lines.en: From up there in the top gallery and around, it will take an extra minute or two.
lines.zh: 從上面最頂層的樓座和周圍走下來，會多花一兩分鐘的時間。

lines.en: And all of you down here that God has spoken to, and in the choir.
lines.zh: 還有在下面這裡，神已經對你說話的所有人，以及在詩班裡的人。

lines.en: You may be a leader in the church.
lines.zh: 你可能是教會裡的領袖。

lines.en: Last night we even had a clergyman come.
lines.zh: 昨晚我們甚至有一位牧師走到台前。

lines.en: But you may want to make that commitment.
lines.zh: 但你可能想要做出那個承諾。

lines.en: I'm going to ask you to make that commitment tonight and say, "Lord, I want a new heart."
lines.zh: 我要請你們今晚做出那個承諾，並說：「主啊，我要一顆新心。」

lines.en: "I want to leave here a new person."
lines.zh: 「我要成為一個新造的人離開這裡。」

lines.en: "I want to walk a different road."
lines.zh: 「我要走一條不同的路。」

lines.en: Jesus said there are two roads.
lines.zh: 耶穌說有兩條路。

lines.en: There's the narrow road and the broad road.
lines.zh: 有窄路和闊路。

lines.en: You're on one or the other.
lines.zh: 你不是在這條路上，就是在那條路上。

lines.en: Which one are you on?
lines.zh: 你在哪一條路上呢？

lines.en: Young people, older people, whoever you are, I'm going to ask you to come stand here publicly.
lines.zh: 年輕人、年長者，無論你是誰，我要請你來到這裡公開地站著。

lines.en: Why do I do it publicly?
lines.zh: 為什麼我要公開地進行呢？

lines.en: When Jesus died on the cross, He died publicly in your place, and God laid on Him all of our sins.
lines.zh: 當耶穌死在十字架上時，祂是公開地代替你死，而且神將我們所有的罪都歸在祂身上。

lines.en: Publicly.
lines.zh: 公開地。

lines.en: He said, "If you're not willing to acknowledge Me publicly before men, I'll not acknowledge you before my Father which is in heaven."
lines.zh: 祂說：「凡在人面前不肯公開認我的，我在我天上的父面前也必不認他。」

lines.en: Something about coming and making it public that He requires.
lines.zh: 祂要求我們走出來並公開承認，這其中是有意義的。

lines.en: And it also psychologically does something for you.
lines.zh: 而且這在心理上對你也有所幫助。

lines.en: And then you must follow Him and serve Him.
lines.zh: 然後你必須跟從祂並服事祂。

lines.en: It's not just a one-time experience.
lines.zh: 這不只是一次性的經歷。

lines.en: This is the beginning of something new that's going to be daily with you in which you're trusting Him.
lines.zh: 這是某種新事物的開始，它將每天與你同在，在其中你不斷地信靠祂。

lines.en: You're willing to take up the cross and deny self and follow Him.
lines.zh: 你願意背起十字架，捨己，並且跟從祂。

lines.en: You're willing to look on your neighbors and the needs of the world in a new way.
lines.zh: 你願意用一種新的眼光來看待你的鄰舍和這世界的需要。

lines.en: I'm going to ask you to get up and come right now.
lines.zh: 我現在就要請你們站起來，走到台前。

lines.en: And after you've all come, I'm going to say a word to you, and have a prayer with you, and give you some literature to help you in your Christian life.
lines.zh: 當你們都來到台前之後，我會對你們說幾句話，並為你們代禱，也會給你們一些文字資料，來幫助你們的基督徒生活。

lines.en: And if you're with your friends or relatives, or you've come in a group, they'll wait, but you get up and come.
lines.zh: 如果你和朋友或親戚在一起，或者你們是結伴而來的，他們會等你的，只要你站起來，走到台前。

lines.en: We're only going to keep you a few moments here.
lines.zh: 我們只會讓你們在這裡留步片刻。

lines.en: Just get up and come right now.
lines.zh: 現在就站起來，走到台前。

lines.en: Hundreds of you that God has spoken to.
lines.zh: 神已經對你們數百人說了話。

lines.en: There's a little voice inside that says you ought to come.
lines.zh: 裡面有一個微小的聲音說你應該過來。

lines.en: You come tonight.
lines.zh: 今晚你就過來。

lines.en: From here, up there, and in the choir.
lines.zh: 從這裡、從上面，以及在詩班裡。

lines.en: God has spoken to some of you.
lines.zh: 神已經對你們當中的一些人說話了。

lines.en: Get up and come.
lines.zh: 站起來，走到台前吧。

lessons.title: A Cure for Heart Trouble
lessons.summaryZh: 把握時間將自己交託給基督，並分享神愛的真理。

lines.en: You can make that decision to follow Jesus Christ,
lines.zh: 你可以做決定來跟隨耶穌基督，

lines.en: just as these many hundreds are doing here in Syracuse, New York.
lines.zh: 就像這幾百位在紐約州雪城這裡的人一樣。

lines.en: The number on your screen is your number to call for spiritual help and counseling,
lines.zh: 你螢幕上的號碼是你可以撥打尋求屬靈幫助和協談的電話，

lines.en: so make that call now.
lines.zh: 所以，現在就打吧。

lines.en: It could be the most important call you've ever made.
lines.zh: 這可能是你打過最重要的一通電話。

lines.en: We're in the Carrier Dome, this beautiful, magnificent structure here in Syracuse, New York, in the central part of the state,
lines.zh: 我們在凱莉圓頂體育場，這個位於紐約州中部雪城美麗宏偉的建築，

lines.en: and what a wonderful part of America this really is.
lines.zh: 這真的是美國一個很棒的地方。

lines.en: And tonight, as you can see, there've been hundreds of people respond to come and make their commitment to Christ,
lines.zh: 今晚，如你所見，已經有數百人回應呼召，前來將自己交託給基督，

lines.en: or to renew their vows to Christ,
lines.zh: 或是重新向基督立下誓言，

lines.en: and you need to do the same thing that are watching.
lines.zh: 而正在觀看的你們，也需要做同樣的事。

lines.en: You may be in a hotel room, you may be in your own home, whatever.
lines.zh: 你可能在飯店房間裡，可能在自己的家裡，無論在哪裡。

lines.en: Make your commitment to Christ tonight.
lines.zh: 今晚就將自己交託給基督吧。

lines.en: He'll come into your heart.
lines.zh: 祂會進入你的心。

lines.en: And if you will, pick up the phone and call that number that you see,
lines.zh: 如果你願意，請拿起電話撥打你看到的那個號碼，

lines.en: and there's a counselor standing by to say a word to you and to help you.
lines.zh: 會有一位協談員在線上跟你說幾句話，並幫助你。

lines.en: May God help you to make that commitment tonight.
lines.zh: 願神幫助你今晚做出委身的決定。

lines.en: God bless you.
lines.zh: 神賜福你。

lines.en: There's still time to make your personal decision for Jesus Christ.
lines.zh: 現在還有時間為耶穌基督做出你個人的決定。

lines.en: Special friends are waiting to talk with you and to pray with you.
lines.zh: 有特別的朋友正等著和你交談，並與你一起禱告。

lines.en: Just call the number now on your screen.
lines.zh: 現在就撥打你螢幕上的號碼。

lines.en: If the line is busy, write the number down and call again in a few moments.
lines.zh: 如果佔線，請把號碼記下來，稍後再打。

lines.en: We'll be here as long as the calls keep coming in.
lines.zh: 只要一直有電話打來，我們就會在這裡。

lines.en: If you just prayed that prayer with my father,
lines.zh: 如果你剛才和我父親一起做了那個禱告，

lines.en: or if you have any questions about a relationship with Jesus Christ,
lines.zh: 或者你對與耶穌基督建立關係有任何問題，

lines.en: why don't you just call that number on the screen.
lines.zh: 為什麼不直接撥打螢幕上的那個號碼呢？

lines.en: There'll be someone there to talk with you, pray with you and answer those questions.
lines.zh: 那裡會有人與你交談、與你一起禱告，並回答那些問題。

lines.en: And remember, God loves you!
lines.zh: 請記住，神愛你！

lines.en: If you would like to commit your life to Jesus Christ,
lines.zh: 如果你想將生命交託給耶穌基督，

lines.en: please call us right now toll free at 1-877-772-4559.
lines.zh: 請現在就撥打我們的免付費電話 1-877-772-4559。

lines.en: Or you can write to us at Billy Graham, 1 Billy Graham Parkway, Department C, Charlotte, North Carolina 28201.
lines.zh: 或者你可以寫信給我們，地址是 Billy Graham, 1 Billy Graham Parkway, Department C, Charlotte, North Carolina 28201。

lines.en: Or you can contact us on the web 24/7 at PeaceWithGod.tv.
lines.zh: 或者你可以全天候在 PeaceWithGod.tv 網站上聯繫我們。

lines.en: We'll get the same helps to you that we give to everyone who responds at the invitation.
lines.zh: 我們會將給予每一位回應呼召之人的相同幫助提供給你。

lines.en: On behalf of Franklin Graham and the Billy Graham Evangelistic Association,
lines.zh: 我代表葛福臨和葛理翰佈道團，

lines.en: thank you for watching, and thank you for your prayers.
lines.zh: 感謝您的收看，也感謝您的代禱。

lines.en: We still have a window of opportunity to reach a lost and dying world with the truth of God's love.
lines.zh: 我們仍有一個機會之窗，可以用神愛的真理去接觸這個迷失且垂死的世界。

lines.en: It's not too late.
lines.zh: 現在還為時不晚。

lines.en: We've got an opportunity to tell others about Jesus Christ.
lines.zh: 我們有一個機會去告訴別人關於耶穌基督的事。

lines.en: What are you going to do with it?
lines.zh: 你打算怎麼運用這個機會呢？

lessons.title: How Worry Chokes God's Promises For Your Life
lessons.titleZh: 憂慮如何扼殺神對你生命的應許
lessons.summaryZh: 憂慮與分心會如同荊棘般扼殺神在我們生命中的應許，我們必須專一尋求神的旨意。

lines.en: Verse 18, these are the ones sown among thorns.
lines.zh: 第十八節，還有那撒在荊棘裡的。

lines.en: They are the ones who hear the word, and the cares of this world, the deceitfulness of riches, and the desires for other things enter in and choke the word.
lines.zh: 就是人聽了道，後來有世上的思慮、錢財的迷惑，和別樣的私慾進來，把道擠住了。

lines.en: Listen to me carefully.
lines.zh: 仔細聽我說。

lines.en: You and I with our thoughts, our attitudes, our appetites have the capacity to put a stranglehold on the promise that God has given.
lines.zh: 你和我的思想、態度與慾望，有能力扼殺神所賜下的應許。

lines.en: He talks here about giving ourselves for weeds to grow.
lines.zh: 祂在這裡談到我們容讓雜草生長。

lines.en: Anybody, anybody a gardener in here?
lines.zh: 這裡有任何人是園丁嗎？

lines.en: I'm not, my wife is, although we just are in the process of doing a wonderful garden, and I'm cheering her on.
lines.zh: 我不是，我太太才是，雖然我們現在正打造一個很棒的花園，而我負責為她加油打氣。

lines.en: "Go, Penny, go!"
lines.zh: 「上啊，潘妮，上啊！」

lines.en: And as soon as my hot peppers are in full bloom, I will help her harvest.
lines.zh: 只要我的辣椒一盛開，我就會幫她採收。

lines.en: That's my responsibility.
lines.zh: 那是我的責任。

lines.en: And we have a little orchard of about 30 trees, and I'm going to pick the apples too.
lines.zh: 我們還有一個大約有三十棵樹的小果園，我也會負責摘蘋果。

lines.en: That's my gardening part.
lines.zh: 那就是我園藝的部分。

lines.en: That's my part, "Go, Penny, give me an apple," fill it in.
lines.zh: 那就是我的部分，「上啊，潘妮，給我一顆蘋果，」幫我填滿空缺。

lines.en: Why do weeds grow bigger, faster, stronger than the plant you want to grow?
lines.zh: 為什麼雜草總是比你想要種植的植物長得更大、更快、更強壯？

lines.en: It's a weird thing, it happened because of the Fall.
lines.zh: 這是一件怪事，這一切都是因為人類墮落而發生的。

lines.en: Here He says weeds grow and choke the word of the Lord.
lines.zh: 在這裡祂說雜草會生長，並把主的話語擠住。

lines.en: The promise of your life can actually be choked, strangled by the deceitfulness of riches, the cares of this world, and the desire for other things.
lines.zh: 你生命的應許實際上可能會被錢財的迷惑、世上的思慮和別樣的私慾所擠住、扼殺。

lines.en: Let me break down those three things for you.
lines.zh: 讓我為你們詳細解說這三件事。

lines.en: The cares of this world.
lines.zh: 世上的思慮。

lines.en: That word for cares actually comes from two words.
lines.zh: 思慮這個詞其實源自兩個字。

lines.en: Number one is divided, and number two is mind.
lines.zh: 第一個是分裂，第二個是心思。

lines.en: Divided mind.
lines.zh: 分裂的心思。

lines.en: Cares of this world is the divided mind.
lines.zh: 世上的思慮就是分裂的心思。

lines.en: A lot of people experience—not you, it's them, other folks—a lot of people experience anxiety, confusion, and stress because their mind is divided.
lines.zh: 許多人經歷到——不是你們，是他們，其他人——許多人經歷到焦慮、混亂和壓力，因為他們的心思是分裂的。

lines.en: Too many options.
lines.zh: 有太多的選擇。

lines.en: Jesus and all these other options.
lines.zh: 耶穌以及所有這些其他的選擇。

lines.en: Years ago, I remember hearing a story, read a story actually in a book about this gentleman.
lines.zh: 多年前，我記得聽過一個故事，其實是在一本書裡讀到關於這位男士的故事。

lines.en: He was a great athlete and loved competition, loved sports of all kinds.
lines.zh: 他是一位偉大的運動員，熱愛競爭，熱愛各種運動。

lines.en: And he ended up in a horrible accident, lost an arm.
lines.zh: 後來他遭遇了一場可怕的意外，失去了一隻手臂。

lines.en: And he spent considerable time after that trying to find some kind of a sport that he could be involved in with only one arm.
lines.zh: 在那之後，他花了相當長的時間試圖尋找某種只有一隻手臂也能參與的運動。

lines.en: And he ended up for some reason picking up the sport called handball.
lines.zh: 不知為何，他最後選擇了這項名叫手球的運動。

lines.en: Anybody ever played handball?
lines.zh: 有人打過手球嗎？

lines.en: Man, that's painful.
lines.zh: 天啊，那很痛。

lines.en: Give me a racket, I'd rather hit the ball with a racket.
lines.zh: 給我一支球拍吧，我寧願用球拍擊球。

lines.en: It's this hard little ball, almost as hard as a golf ball, that you hit off your hand that has a thin layer of leather over each hand.
lines.zh: 那是一種堅硬的小球，幾乎和高爾夫球一樣硬，你要雙手各戴著一層薄薄的皮手套去擊球。

lines.en: You hit it off the wall as in racquetball, and it's a very intense and competitive sport.
lines.zh: 你就像打壁球一樣把它打向牆壁，這是一項非常激烈且具競爭性的運動。

lines.en: So he picked up this particular sport called handball, and he became so good over time he became the club champion.
lines.zh: 所以他開始接觸這項名叫手球的特定運動，隨著時間過去，他變得非常厲害，成為了俱樂部冠軍。

lines.en: And then his club entered him in the state championship, and he competed on a statewide level.
lines.zh: 然後他的俱樂部為他報名了州冠軍賽，他在全州級別的比賽中競爭。

lines.en: And he ended up taking first place in his state for handball.
lines.zh: 最終他在全州手球比賽中獲得了第一名。

lines.en: Following his championship match, a newspaper writer wanted to interview him.
lines.zh: 在他的冠軍賽之後，一位報社記者想採訪他。

lines.en: So he interviewed him, and one of his questions he says, "How is it that a man with only one hand can defeat all your opponents that play with two hands?"
lines.zh: 於是記者採訪了他，他其中一個問題問道：「一個只有一隻手的人，怎麼能擊敗所有用兩隻手打球的對手呢？」

lines.en: And he said, "Oh, it's easy."
lines.zh: 他說：「喔，這很簡單。」

lines.en: He said, "Options."
lines.zh: 他說：「選擇。」

lines.en: And the newspaper guy said, "What do you mean, options?"
lines.zh: 那位記者說：「什麼意思，選擇？」

lines.en: He said, "When the ball comes off the wall, my opponent has to decide what hand to use."
lines.zh: 他說：「當球從牆上彈回來時，我的對手必須決定要用哪隻手。」

lines.en: "I only had one option, the decision had been made."
lines.zh: 「我只有一個選擇，決定早就做好了。」

lines.en: Too many Christians have too many options, and we invite confusion.
lines.zh: 太多基督徒有太多的選擇，於是我們招致了混亂。

lines.en: When you invite confusion, you actually create the atmosphere for anxiety, worry, all of those things.
lines.zh: 當你招致混亂時，你實際上就製造了讓焦慮、憂慮和所有這類事情滋生的氛圍。

lines.en: It doesn't mean we would never face it otherwise, it's just we always have the upper hand when we only have one option.
lines.zh: 這並不意味著如果是別種情況我們就永遠不會面對它，只是當我們只有一個選擇時，我們總是能佔上風。

lines.en: When our only option is, "I am hungry for the will of God."
lines.zh: 當我們唯一的選擇是：「我飢渴慕義地尋求神的旨意。」

lines.en: "I don't care what it tastes like in the moment, it's what I'm hungry for, it's what I want."
lines.zh: 「我不在乎它此刻嚐起來是什麼味道，這就是我所渴慕的，這就是我想要的。」

lines.en: Jesus said, "My food is to do the will of Him who sent me."
lines.zh: 耶穌說：「我的食物就是遵行差我來者的旨意。」

lines.en: The will of God sometimes is very sour or bitter to the taste, but it's always pleasant to the stomach.
lines.zh: 神的旨意有時嚐起來很酸或很苦，但對胃來說總是舒適的。

lines.en: The will of man is always sweet to the taste, but it turns sour in the stomach.
lines.zh: 人的旨意嚐起來總是甜的，但在胃裡卻會變酸。

lines.en: And there's something about the will of God that nourishes and strengthens.
lines.zh: 神的旨意中有一種能帶來滋養和力量的特質。

lines.en: So here we have this issue of the cares of life.
lines.zh: 所以在這裡我們看到了世上思慮的問題。

lines.en: So think about it this way, every moment that you and I spend in worry and anxiety, we are actually feeding the beast that strangles the promise over our destiny.
lines.zh: 所以這樣想吧，你和我在憂慮和焦慮中所度過的每一刻，我們其實都在餵養那隻扼殺我們命定應許的野獸。

lines.en: Every moment that I spend in worry and anxiety, I'm actually fueling, I'm feeding the beast that is working to put a stranglehold over my destiny, over the promises of my life.
lines.zh: 我在憂慮和焦慮中所度過的每一刻，我實際上都在助長、在餵養那隻正企圖扼殺我命定、扼殺我生命應許的野獸。

lines.en: The devil cannot read our thoughts.
lines.zh: 魔鬼無法讀透我們的思想。

lines.en: Anybody say amen to that?
lines.zh: 有人對此說阿們嗎？

lines.en: He cannot read your thoughts, but he can read the thoughts he suggests.
lines.zh: 牠無法讀透你的思想，但牠能讀懂牠所暗示的那些思想。

lines.en: And I think he can sometimes tell when one of his suggestions, called fiery darts, has made it past the shield of faith, because it affects our countenance.
lines.zh: 而且我認為，有時牠能看出牠那被稱為『火箭』的暗示何時穿透了信心的盾牌，因為那會影響我們的面容。

lines.en: And whenever that has happened, there is an agreement.
lines.zh: 而每當這種情況發生時，就產生了一種同意。

lines.en: And the enemy is always empowered by our agreement.
lines.zh: 仇敵總是藉由我們的同意而獲得能力。

lines.en: Agreeing with the enemy empowers him to kill, steal, destroy.
lines.zh: 與仇敵同意，就賦予了牠殺害、偷竊、毀壞的能力。

lines.en: I don't want to over-exaggerate the devil's role, but I do want to make us alert in the assignment.
lines.zh: 我不想過度誇大魔鬼的角色，但我確實希望我們在任務中保持警醒。

lines.en: Because I believe so much, I've talked about this subject from different angles a lot in the last year.
lines.zh: 因為我深信不疑，過去一年裡我從不同角度談論過很多次這個主題。

lines.en: I feel like we're coming into a season of unusual breakthrough, but it requires the fulfillment of promise.
lines.zh: 我覺得我們正在進入一個非比尋常的突破季節，但這需要應許的成就。

lines.en: How many of you have a whole bunch of promises over your life that are not yet fulfilled?
lines.zh: 你們當中有多少人，生命中有一大堆尚未成就的應許？

lines.en: Amen, all right.
lines.zh: 阿們，好的。

lines.en: So here we have the cares of this world.
lines.zh: 所以在這裡我們看到了世上的思慮。

lessons.title: How to Hear God’s Voice Every Day
lessons.titleZh: 每天如何聆聽神的聲音
lessons.summaryZh: 牧師分享了對神同在的體會，並穿插了幾個關於婚姻角色的幽默笑話。

lines.en: Every one of us have had the experience where we just randomly called a friend,
lines.zh: 我們每個人都有過這樣的經歷，就是我們隨便打給一個朋友，

lines.en: and come to find out it was the exact moment of crisis, and they needed help, and we didn't know.
lines.zh: 結果發現那正是他們面臨危機的時刻，他們需要幫助，而我們並不知情。

lines.en: It wasn't this thundering voice;
lines.zh: 那並不是某種雷鳴般的聲音；

lines.en: it's the subtle leaning into a lifestyle of the presence of God, the Spirit of God,
lines.zh: 而是微妙地投入一種有神同在、聖靈同在的生活方式，
